title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 洪武元年春正月乙亥，祀天地於南郊，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu, spring, the first month, on the day yihai, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb and thereupon assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Hongwu, on the yihai day of the first month, the Hongwu Emperor offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 定有天下之號曰明，建元洪武。

translations.literal: He fixed the designation for possessing All-under-Heaven as Ming and established the reign era Hongwu.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed the dynastic name Ming for his rule over the realm and adopted Hongwu as the reign title.

sentences.zh: 追尊高祖考曰玄皇帝，廟號德祖，曾祖考曰恆皇帝，廟號懿祖；

translations.literal: Posthumously he honored his great-great-grandfather with the title Emperor Xuan, temple name Dezū, and his great-grandfather with the title Emperor Heng, temple name Yìzǔ;
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously elevated his great-great-grandfather to Emperor Xuan, with the temple name Dezū, and his great-grandfather to Emperor Heng, with the temple name Yìzǔ;

sentences.zh: 祖考曰裕皇帝，廟號熙祖，皇考曰淳皇帝，廟號仁祖，妣皆皇后。

translations.literal: his grandfather with the title Emperor Yu, temple name Xīzǔ; his father with the title Emperor Chun, temple name Rénzǔ—all their consorts were titled Empress.
translations.idiomatic: his grandfather to Emperor Yu, temple name Xīzǔ; his father to Emperor Chun, temple name Rénzǔ—with each of their wives honored as Empress.

sentences.zh: 立妃馬氏為皇后，世子標為皇太子。

translations.literal: He installed Consort Ma as Empress and the heir Zhu Biao as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: He made Consort Ma empress and named the heir apparent, Zhu Biao, crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以李善長、徐達為左、右丞相，諸功臣進爵有差。

translations.literal: He appointed Li Shanchang and Xu Da as Left and Right Grand Councillors; the various meritorious officials were advanced in rank according to their respective merits.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang and Xu Da were named left and right grand councillors, and the founding ministers received promotions of varying degree.

sentences.zh: 丙子，頒即位詔於天下。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he promulgated the accession edict throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the enthronement edict was issued throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 追封皇伯考以下皆為王。

translations.literal: Posthumously he enfeoffed his father's elder brothers and those below them all as kings.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously granted royal titles to his father's elder brothers and their descendants.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李善長、徐達等兼東宮官。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others concurrently held Eastern Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Li Shanchang, Xu Da, and others were given additional posts in the crown prince's establishment.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣使覈浙西田賦。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he dispatched envoys to verify the land tax in western Zhèjiāng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, commissioners were sent to audit land taxes in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，胡廷瑞克建寧。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hu Tingrui captured Jiàníng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Hu Tingrui took Jianning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征戍將軍，略南陽以北州郡。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu was made Campaigning Garrison General and reduced the prefectures and districts north of Nányáng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu was appointed campaigning garrison general and marched to subdue the regions north of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 湯和克延平，執元平章陳友定，福建平。

translations.literal: Tang He captured Yánping, seized the Yuan Vice Councillor Chén Yǒudìng, and Fújiàn was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Tang He seized Yanping and captured the Yuan vice councillor Chen Youding, bringing Fujian under control.

sentences.zh: 是月，天下府州縣官來朝。

translations.literal: That month, officials of prefectures, departments, and districts from throughout the realm came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, magistrates from prefectures, departments, and counties across the empire presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「天下始定，民財力俱困，要在休養安息，惟廉者能約己而利人，勉之。

translations.literal: He instructed, saying: "All-under-Heaven has just been settled; the people's wealth and strength are alike exhausted—the essential thing is to rest and allow recovery. Only the incorrupt can restrain themselves and benefit others. Exert yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: He admonished them: "The realm has only just been pacified, and the people's resources are utterly depleted. What matters now is recovery and repose. Only the upright, who curb themselves and serve others, can achieve this—strive for that."

sentences.zh: 」二月壬寅，定郊社宗廟禮，歲必親祀，以為常。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin—the rites for suburban altars, altars of soil and grain, and ancestral temples were fixed; each year he must personally sacrifice, and this was taken as the constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day, the rituals for the suburban sacrifices, the altars of soil and grain, and the ancestral temples were standardized; the emperor would perform them in person every year as established custom.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和提督海運。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tang He was made Supervisor-in-Chief of maritime transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Tang He was appointed to oversee sea transport.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠為征南將軍，硃亮祖副之，由海道取廣東。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong was made Southern Campaigning General; Zhu Liangzu served as his deputy; by the sea route they took Guǎngdōng.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong was named southern campaigning general, with Zhu Liangzu as his deputy, to seize Guangdong by sea.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乙太牢祀先師孔子於國學。

translations.literal: On dingwei, with the yi great offering he sacrificed to the First Teacher Confucius at the National Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, he offered the great sacrifice to Confucius at the National University.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀社稷。

translations.literal: On wushen, he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, he performed the rites at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔衣冠如唐制。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered that caps and robes follow the Táng system.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, an edict decreed that court dress should follow Tang dynasty regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，常遇春克東昌，山東平。

translations.literal: On guichou, Chang Yuchun captured Dōngchāng; Shāndōng was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Chang Yuchun took Dongchang, completing the pacification of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，楊璟克寶慶。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Yang Jing captured Bǎoqìng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Yang Jing captured Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔儒臣修女誡，戒後妃毋預政。

translations.literal: Third month, xinwei—an edict ordered Confucian ministers to compile Admonitions for Women, warning consorts not to interfere in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinwei day, an edict directed scholarly officials to compile Admonitions for Women, forbidding imperial consorts from meddling in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，周德興克全州。

translations.literal: On renshen, Zhou Dexing captured Quánzhōu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Zhou Dexing seized Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鄧愈克南陽。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Deng Yu captured Nányáng.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Deng Yu took Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，徐達徇汴梁，左君弼降。

translations.literal: On jihai, Xu Da advanced upon Biànliáng; Zuǒ Jūnbì surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Xu Da marched on Bianliang, and Zuo Junbi submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，蘄州進竹簟，卻之，命四方毋妄獻。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou—Qízhōu presented bamboo mats; he declined them and ordered the four quarters not to present gifts rashly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Qizhou offered bamboo sleeping mats; the emperor refused them and commanded that no region should send unsolicited tribute.

sentences.zh: 廖永忠師至廣州，元守臣何真降，廣東平。

translations.literal: Liao Yongzhong's army reached Guǎngzhōu; the Yuan defending official He Zhen surrendered; Guǎngdōng was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yongzhong's forces reached Guangzhou, where the Yuan defender He Zhen surrendered, bringing Guangdong under Ming control.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祫享太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the combined seasonal offering was performed at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the seasonal rites merging ancestral spirits were held at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐達、常遇春大破元兵於洛水北，遂圍河南。

translations.literal: On wushen, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun greatly defeated Yuan troops north of the Luò River and then besieged Hénán.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun routed the Yuan army north of the Luo River and laid siege to Henan.

sentences.zh: 梁王阿魯溫降，河南平。

translations.literal: Prince of Liang Aruwen surrendered; Hénán was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Liang, Aruwen, submitted, and Henan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，楊璟克永州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yang Jing captured Yǒngzhōu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Yang Jing took Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸汴梁。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he visited Biànliáng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the emperor traveled to Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，馮勝克潼關，李思齊、張思道遁。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Feng Sheng captured Tóngguān; Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Feng Sheng seized Tong Pass while Li Siqi and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，廖永忠下梧州，潯、貴、容、郁林諸州皆降。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jimao—Liao Yongzhong took down Wúzhōu; Xún, Guì, Róng, and Yùlín and the various prefectures all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jimao day, Liao Yongzhong captured Wuzhou, and the prefectures of Xun, Gui, Rong, and Yulin all submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改汴梁路為開封府。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Biànliáng Circuit was changed to Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Bianliang Circuit was redesignated Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，徐達朝行在。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi—Xu Da attended the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, Xu Da presented himself at the imperial headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，海南、海北諸道降。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Hǎinán, Hǎiběi, and the various circuits surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the circuits of Hainan and Haibei submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊璟、硃亮祖克靖江。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu captured Jìngjiāng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Yang Jing and Zhu Liangzu took Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，廖永忠下象州，廣西平。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuzi—Liao Yongzhong took down Xiàngzhōu; Guǎngxī was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the wuzi day, Liao Yongzhong captured Xiangzhou, completing the pacification of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，振恤中原貧民。

translations.literal: On gengyin, he provided relief to the impoverished people of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, relief was extended to the destitute of the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，將還應天，諭達等曰：「中原之民，久為群雄所苦，流離相望，故命將北征，拯民水火。

translations.literal: On xinmao, about to return to Yìngtiān, he instructed Xu Da and others, saying: "The people of the Central Plains have long suffered at the hands of rival warlords, wandering in exile and gazing at one another from afar; therefore I ordered generals on the northern campaign to rescue the people from flood and fire."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, as he prepared to return to Yingtian, he addressed Xu Da and his commanders: "The people of the Central Plains have endured years of warlord depredation, scattering in desperate exile. That is why I sent you north—to pluck them from fire and flood."

sentences.zh: 元祖宗功德在人，其子孫罔恤民隱，天厭棄之。

translations.literal: The Yuan founders' merit and virtue remain in the hearts of the people, yet their descendants heed not the people's hidden sufferings—Heaven has grown weary and cast them off.
translations.idiomatic: The founders of the Yuan earned the people's gratitude, yet their heirs ignored the people's plight, until Heaven itself turned against them.

sentences.zh: 君則有罪，民復何辜。

translations.literal: The ruler then has guilt—what crime have the people again committed?
translations.idiomatic: If the sovereign is guilty, what fault lies with the common people?

sentences.zh: 前代革命之際，肆行屠戮，違天虐民，朕實不忍。

translations.literal: At the time of revolution in former ages, they wantonly carried out slaughter, violating Heaven and brutalizing the people—I truly cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Past dynastic upheavals brought slaughter that defied Heaven and ravaged the people—something I cannot bring myself to repeat.

sentences.zh: 諸將克城，毋肆焚掠妄殺人，元之宗戚，咸俾保全。

translations.literal: When you generals capture cities, do not wantonly burn, plunder, or kill without cause; the Yuan imperial clansmen—all are to be allowed to be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When you take a city, do not burn, loot, or kill indiscriminately. Preserve the Yuan imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 庶幾上答天心，下慰人望，以副朕伐罪安民之意。

translations.literal: Thus perhaps above you may answer Heaven's heart, below comfort the people's hopes, and fulfill my intent in punishing guilt and bringing peace to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Thus you may answer Heaven above and satisfy the people's hopes below, fulfilling my purpose of punishing the guilty while sparing the innocent.

sentences.zh: 不恭命者，罰無赦。

translations.literal: Those who do not respect the command—punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever disobeys this order shall be punished without mercy.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，命馮勝留守開封。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he ordered Feng Sheng to remain and garrison Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Feng Sheng was ordered to remain and guard Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，至自開封。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dingwei, he arrived from Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the intercalary month, he returned from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 己酉，徐達會諸將兵於臨清。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Xu Da assembled the various generals' troops at Línqīng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Xu Da gathered the commanders' forces at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，常遇春克德州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Chang Yuchun captured Dézhōu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Chang Yuchun took Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，克通州，元帝趨上都。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he captured Tōngzhōu; the Yuan emperor hastened to Shàngdū.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Tongzhou fell, and the Yuan emperor fled north to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 是月，征天下賢才為守令。

translations.literal: That month, he summoned men of talent throughout the realm to serve as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the court recruited talented men empire-wide to serve as local administrators.

sentences.zh: 免吳江、慶德、太平、甯國、滁、和被災田租。

translations.literal: He remitted the land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Wújiāng, Qìngdé, Tàipíng, Níngguó, Chú, and Hé.
translations.idiomatic: Land taxes were waived for disaster-affected districts in Wujiang, Qingde, Taiping, Ningguo, Chu, and He.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，以應天為南京，開封為北京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jisi—he made Yìngtiān the Southern Capital and Kaifeng the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jisi day, Yingtian was designated the Southern Capital and Kaifeng the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，徐達入元都，封府庫圖籍，守宮門，禁士卒侵暴，遣將巡古北口諸隘。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, guarded the palace gates, forbade the soldiers from violating and brutalizing the people, and dispatched generals to patrol the passes at Gǔběikǒu and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Xu Da entered the Yuan capital, sealed the treasuries and archives, posted guards at the palace gates, prohibited looting by the troops, and sent officers to patrol the passes at Gubeikou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以京師火，四方水旱，詔中書省集議便民事。

translations.literal: On renshen, because of fire in the capital and flood and drought in the four quarters, he edicted the Secretariat to assemble and deliberate on measures convenient to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, in response to fires in the capital and floods and droughts across the realm, the Secretariat was ordered to convene and propose measures to ease the people's burdens.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定六部官制。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the official system of the Six Ministries was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the bureaucratic structure of the six ministries was established.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞劉基致仕。

translations.literal: Censor Vice Commissioner Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, vice censor-in-chief, resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 己卯，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On jimao, he amnestied those below the punishment of extraordinary death.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, amnesty was granted for crimes short of capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 將士從征者恤其家，逋逃許自首。

translations.literal: Soldiers and officers who had followed on campaign—their families were given relief; fugitives were permitted to surrender themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Families of soldiers on campaign received relief; deserters were allowed to surrender without penalty.

sentences.zh: 新克州郡毋妄殺。

translations.literal: In newly captured prefectures and districts, do not kill without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Indiscriminate killing was forbidden in newly conquered territories.

sentences.zh: 輸賦道遠者，官為轉運，災荒以實聞。

translations.literal: Those whose tax deliveries were by distant routes—the government would transport on their behalf; regarding disaster and famine, report the facts truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: Where tax transport was impractically distant, officials would handle conveyance; reports of famine and disaster must reflect actual conditions.

sentences.zh: 免鎮江租稅。

translations.literal: Rents and taxes in Zhènjiāng were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes in Zhenjiang were remitted.

sentences.zh: 避亂民復業者，聽墾荒地，復三年。

translations.literal: People who had fled the turmoil and returned to their occupations were permitted to open wasteland for cultivation and given three years' exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees returning to their livelihoods might reclaim wasteland with a three-year tax holiday.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公襲封及授曲阜知縣，並如前代制。

translations.literal: The Duke Continuing the Sage's line received successive enfeoffment, and the magistrate of Qūfù was appointed—all as under former dynasties' regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The title Duke Yansheng was conferred in succession, and an official was appointed magistrate of Qufu, following precedent of earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 有司以禮聘致賢士，學校毋事虛文。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were to engage worthy gentlemen by ritual invitation; schools were not to pursue empty rhetoric.
translations.idiomatic: Local authorities were to recruit worthy scholars with proper ceremony; schools must abandon hollow formalism.

sentences.zh: 平刑，毋非時決囚。

translations.literal: The punishments were to be made equitable; do not execute prisoners out of season.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments were to be applied equitably, with no irregular executions.

sentences.zh: 除書籍田器稅，民間逋負免征。

translations.literal: Taxes on books, farm implements, and fields were abolished; popular arrears in payment were exempted from collection.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on books, farming tools, and land were repealed, and private debts to the state were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、色目人有才能者，許擢用。

translations.literal: Mongols and Semu persons who had ability were permitted to be elevated and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Talented Mongols and Central Asians (Semu) were eligible for government appointment.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨廢疾者，存恤之。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and the infirm were to be sustained and comforted.
translations.idiomatic: The widowed, orphaned, childless, disabled, and infirm were to receive state care.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，一子復。

translations.literal: Commoners aged seventy and above—one son was exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Households with a member over seventy received corvée exemption for one son.

sentences.zh: 他利害當興革不在詔內者，有司具以聞。

translations.literal: Other benefits and harms that ought to be instituted or abolished and were not within the edict—the responsible offices were to report them in full.
translations.idiomatic: Other reforms not covered by the edict were to be reported by officials in detail.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸北京。

translations.literal: On renwu, he visited the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor traveled to the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改大都路曰北平府。

translations.literal: Dàdū Circuit was changed to say Běipíng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu Circuit was redesignated Beiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 征元故臣。

translations.literal: He summoned former Yuan ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yuan officials were summoned to serve.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔徐達、常遇春取山西。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict ordered Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to take Shānxī.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun were ordered to conquer Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，放元宮人。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Yuan palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, women of the Yuan palace were set free.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔曰：「天下之治，天下之賢共理之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guihai—an edict said: "The ordering of All-under-Heaven—men of worth throughout All-under-Heaven together govern it."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, an edict declared: "To govern the realm requires the worthy of the realm to govern together with the throne."

sentences.zh: 今賢士多隱岩穴，豈有司失於敦勸歟，朝廷疏於禮待歟，抑朕寡昧不足致賢，將在位者壅蔽使不上達歟？

translations.literal: "Now men of worth mostly hide in mountain caves—is it that the responsible offices have failed in earnest encouragement, that the court has been remiss in courteous treatment, or that I am lacking and insufficient to bring worthies forth, or that those in office block and obstruct so that they do not reach above?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet many worthy men remain in seclusion. Is it that local officials have failed to encourage them, that the court has neglected them, that I lack the virtue to attract talent, or that those in power block their path to the throne?

sentences.zh: 不然，賢士大夫，幼學壯行，豈甘沒世而已哉。

translations.literal: "If not so, worthy scholar-officials who study in youth and act in strength—how could they be content merely to vanish into the world without renown?"
translations.idiomatic: Surely men of learning and principle, trained from youth for service, do not wish to die obscure and unused.

sentences.zh: 天下甫定，朕願與諸儒講明治道。

translations.literal: "All-under-Heaven has just been settled; I wish to discuss and clarify the way of governing with the various Confucians."
translations.idiomatic: The realm is newly pacified, and I desire to deliberate on good governance with the scholarly elite.

sentences.zh: 有能輔朕濟民者，有司禮遣。

translations.literal: "Those who can assist me and bring relief to the people—the responsible offices are to send them with ritual courtesy."
translations.idiomatic: Let those who can aid me in serving the people be respectfully escorted to court by local authorities.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，常遇春下保定，遂下真定。

translations.literal: On yichou, Chang Yuchun took down Bǎodìng and then took down Zhēndìng.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Chang Yuchun captured Baoding and then Zhending.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，馮勝、湯和下懷慶，澤、潞相繼下。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengwu—Feng Sheng and Tang He took down Huáiqìng; Zé and Lù successively fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengwu day, Feng Sheng and Tang He captured Huaiqing, followed by the fall of Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，至自北京。

translations.literal: On dingchou, he arrived from the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the emperor returned from the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以元都平，詔天下。

translations.literal: On wuyin, because the Yuan capital had been pacified, he edicted the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an empire-wide edict announced the pacification of the Yuan capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，遣使分行天下，訪求賢才。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jihai—he dispatched envoys to travel separately throughout the realm, seeking out men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai day, envoys were dispatched throughout the empire to seek out men of talent.

sentences.zh: 庚子，始祀上帝於圜丘。

translations.literal: On gengzi, for the first time he sacrificed to the Supreme Lord at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the emperor performed the first sacrifice to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔劉基還。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict recalled Liu Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Liu Ji was summoned back to office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，徐達克太原，擴廓帖木兒走甘肅，山西平。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingmao—Xu Da captured Tàiyuán; Köke Temür fled to Gānsù; Shānxī was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, Xu Da took Taiyuan; Köke Temür fled to Gansu, and Shanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置登聞鼓。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Petition-by-Drum was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Petition Drum was established at court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以書諭明昇。

translations.literal: On renchen, by letter he instructed Míng Shēng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, a letter was sent instructing Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙巳，立功臣廟於雞籠山。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, yisi—a Meritorious Officials Temple was established on Jīlóng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on the yisi day of the first month, a temple honoring meritorious officials was established on Jilong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he performed the offering at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, offerings were presented at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「朕淮右布衣，因天下亂，率眾渡江，保民圖治，今十有五年。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict said: "I, a common-cloth man of the Huái right, because All-under-Heaven was in disorder, led the multitude across the river to protect the people and seek good governance—now fully fifteen years."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, an edict proclaimed: "I was but a commoner of Huaiyou. When the realm fell into chaos, I led my followers across the Yangzi to shelter the people and seek order—now fifteen years have passed."

sentences.zh: 荷天眷祐，悉皆戡定。

translations.literal: Bearing Heaven's favor and blessing, all have been pacified by force.
translations.idiomatic: By Heaven's grace, all adversaries have been subdued.

sentences.zh: 用是命將北征，齊魯之民饋糧給軍，不憚千里。

translations.literal: For this reason I ordered generals on the northern expedition; the people of Qí and Lǔ provisioned grain to supply the army, not fearing a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Hence I sent armies north; the people of Qi and Lu supplied grain to the troops without hesitation, traveling a thousand li to do so.

sentences.zh: 朕軫厥勞，已免元年田租。

translations.literal: I have sympathized with their toil and have already remitted the first year's land tax.
translations.idiomatic: I have taken pity on their labor and already remitted the land tax for the first year.

sentences.zh: 遭旱民未蘇，其更賜一年。

translations.literal: Having suffered drought, the people have not yet recovered; let them be granted exemption for one more year.
translations.idiomatic: Because drought had struck and the people had not yet recovered, another year's exemption was granted.

sentences.zh: 頃者大軍平燕都，下晉、冀，民被兵燹，困征斂，北平、燕南、河東、山西今年田租亦與蠲免。

translations.literal: Recently the great army pacified the Yan capital and subdued Jin and Ji; the people suffered the ravages of war and were burdened by levies—Beiping, south of Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi shall likewise have this year's land tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Not long ago the main army had pacified the Yan capital and overrun Jin and Ji. The people had suffered war's devastation and crushing levies; land tax for the current year in Beiping, southern Yan, Hedong, and Shanxi was likewise remitted.

sentences.zh: 河南諸郡歸附，久欲惠之，西北未平，師過其地，是以未遑。

translations.literal: The various prefectures of Henan submitted; long had I wished to show them favor, but the northwest was not yet pacified and troops passed through their lands, and so I had not been able to do so.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures of Henan had long since submitted, and I had long wished to show them favor; because the northwest was not yet pacified and armies marched through their territory, I had been unable to do so until now.

sentences.zh: 今晉、冀平矣，西抵潼關，北界大河，南至唐、鄧、光、息，今年稅糧悉除之。

translations.literal: Now Jin and Ji are pacified—west to Tong Pass, north bounded by the Great River, south to Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi—this year's grain taxes are all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Jin and Ji were pacified—west to Tong Pass, north to the Yellow River, south through Tang, Deng, Guang, and Xi—all grain taxes for the current year were abolished.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「應天、太平、鎮江、宣城、廣德供億浩穰。

translations.literal: Again he issued an edict, saying: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde bear supply burdens heavy and vast.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict read: "Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Xuancheng, and Guangde bear extraordinarily heavy supply burdens.

sentences.zh: 去歲蠲租，遇旱惠不及下。

translations.literal: Last year's rent remission, encountering drought, did not reach those below.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's rent remission, combined with drought, had not fully benefited the common people.

sentences.zh: 其再免諸郡及無為州今年租稅。

translations.literal: Let the various prefectures and Wuhu Prefecture again be exempted from this year's rent and tax."
translations.idiomatic: Rent and tax for the current year were again remitted in those prefectures and in Wuhu."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，常遇春取大同。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chang Yuchun took Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Chang Yuchun captured Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東濱海郡縣。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided the coastal prefectures and counties of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates attacked coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，詔修元史。

translations.literal: Second month, bingyin first day of the month—an edict ordered the compilation of the History of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the bingyin day, an edict ordered work on the History of the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On renwu, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，徐達至奉元，張思道遁。

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi—Xu Da reached Fengyuan; Zhang Sidao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month, Xu Da reached Fengyuan and Zhang Sidao fled.

sentences.zh: 振陝西饑，戶米三石。

translations.literal: Relief was extended to Shaanxi famine—three shi of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: Famine relief was sent to Shaanxi at three shi of grain per household.

sentences.zh: 丙午，常遇春至鳳翔，李思齊奔臨洮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang; Li Siqi fled to Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Chang Yuchun reached Fengxiang while Li Siqi fled to Lintao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遇春還師北平。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingyin—Yuchun returned his army to Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingyin day, Yuchun marched his army back to Beiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諸王子受經於博士孔克仁。

translations.literal: On jisi, the various princes received the classics from Erudite Kong Keren.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the imperial princes began studying the classics under Erudite Kong Keren.

sentences.zh: 令功臣子弟入學。

translations.literal: He ordered the sons and younger brothers of meritorious ministers to enter school.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of founding ministers were ordered to enroll in the schools.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，編《祖訓錄》，定封建諸王之制。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Records of Ancestral Admonitions was compiled and the system of enfeoffment for the various kings was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Records of Ancestral Admonitions was compiled and regulations for enfeoffing princes were established.

sentences.zh: 徐達下鞏昌。

translations.literal: Xu Da subdued Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da took Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜秦、隴新附州縣稅糧。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he bestowed grain-tax remission on the newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, grain taxes were remitted in the newly submitted prefectures and counties of Qin and Long.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馮勝至臨洮，李思齊降。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Feng Sheng reached Lintao; Li Siqi submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Feng Sheng reached Lintao and Li Siqi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐達襲破元豫王於西寧。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xu Da launched a surprise attack and defeated the Yuan Prince of Yu at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xu Da routed the Yuan Prince of Yu in a surprise attack at Xining.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu first day—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, the jiawu day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，徐達下平涼、延安。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Xu Da subdued Pingliang and Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Xu Da captured Pingliang and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 張良臣以慶陽降，尋叛。

translations.literal: Zhang Liangchen submitted with Qingyang, but soon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liangchen surrendered from Qingyang but soon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，始祀地於方丘。

translations.literal: On guimao, he first sacrificed to Earth at the square mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, sacrifice to Earth was first performed at the square altar.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，常遇春克開平，元帝北走。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao—Chang Yuchun captured Kaiping; the Yuan emperor fled north.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the sixth month, Chang Yuchun took Kaiping and the Yuan emperor fled north.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封陳日煃為安南國王。

translations.literal: On renwu, Chen Rixuan was enfeoffed as King of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Chen Rixuan was enfeoffed as king of Annan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，鄂國公常遇春卒於軍，詔李文忠領其眾。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jihai—the Duke of E Chang Yuchun died in camp; an edict ordered Li Wenzhong to command his forces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the seventh month in autumn, Duke of E Chang Yuchun died in the field; Li Wenzhong was ordered to take command of his army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，擴廓帖木兒遣將破原州、涇州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Köke Temür sent generals who captured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Köke Temür's generals seized Yuanzhou and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，馮勝擊走之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Feng Sheng attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，明昇遣使來。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Ming Sheng sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Ming Sheng dispatched envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，元兵攻大同，李文忠擊敗之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingyin—Yuan troops attacked Datong; Li Wenzhong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the eighth month, Yuan forces attacked Datong and Li Wenzhong repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，定內侍官制。

translations.literal: On jisi, the eunuch official system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, regulations for the eunuch bureaucracy were established.

sentences.zh: 諭吏部曰：「內臣但備使令，毋多人，古來若輩擅權，可為鑒戒。

translations.literal: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel, saying: "Palace servants are only to carry out assignments—do not employ many. Throughout history such men have monopolized power; this may serve as warning.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the Ministry of Personnel: "Eunuchs are only to carry out orders—do not employ too many. History shows how such men seize power; let that be your warning.

sentences.zh: 馭之之道，當使之畏法，勿令有功，有功則驕恣矣。

translations.literal: The way to control them is to make them fear the law; do not let them achieve merit—for merit brings arrogance and license."
translations.idiomatic: The way to govern them is to make them fear the law. Do not let them earn merit, for merit breeds arrogance and excess."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，《元史》成。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the History of Yuan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the History of the Yuan was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封王顓為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Wang Zhuan was enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，徐達克慶陽，斬張良臣，陝西平。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Xu Da captured Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Xu Da took Qingyang, executed Zhang Liangchen, and Shaanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是月，命儒臣纂禮書。

translations.literal: That month, he ordered Confucian officials to compile a book of rites.
translations.idiomatic: That month, scholar-officials were ordered to compile a ritual compendium.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，召徐達、湯和還，馮勝留總軍事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinchou—Xu Da and Tang He were recalled; Feng Sheng remained to oversee military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the ninth month, Xu Da and Tang He were recalled while Feng Sheng stayed behind as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以臨濠為中都。

translations.literal: On guimao, Linhao was made the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Linhao was designated the central capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，征南師還。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the southern campaign army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the southern expeditionary force returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣楊璟諭明昇。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renxu—Yang Jing was dispatched to instruct Ming Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month in winter, Yang Jing was sent to deliver an imperial message to Ming Sheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，甘露降於鐘山，群臣請告廟，不許。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, sweet dew descended on Zhong Mountain; the officials requested to report it at the ancestral temple, but he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, sweet dew fell on Zhong Mountain. The court officials asked to report the omen at the ancestral temple, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔天下郡縣立學。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered every prefecture and county throughout the realm to establish schools.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict ordered schools established in every prefecture and county.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使貽元帝書。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were sent presenting a letter to the Yuan emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were dispatched with a letter to the Yuan emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，祀上帝於圜丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yisi—he sacrificed to the Lord-on-High at the round mound, with the Benevolent Ancestor as secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the eleventh month, sacrifice was offered to Heaven at the round altar, with the Benevolent Ancestor as co-sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，封阿答阿者為占城國王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu—A Da'a Zhe was enfeoffed as King of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month, A Da'a Zhe was enfeoffed as king of Champa.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振西安諸府饑，戶米二石。

translations.literal: On jiashen, famine relief was extended to the various prefectures of Xi'an—two shi of grain per household.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, famine relief was sent to the prefectures around Xi'an at two shi per household.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大賚平定中原及征南將士。

translations.literal: On jichou, great rewards were bestowed on the troops who had pacified the Central Plain and the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, lavish rewards were granted to the armies that had pacified the Central Plain and campaigned in the south.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，擴廓帖木兒攻蘭州，指揮於光死之。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou; Commander Yu Guang died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Köke Temür attacked Lanzhou and Commander Yu Guang was killed in the defense.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Champa, Annan, and Goryeo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸巳，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，分道北征。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, guisi—Xu Da was made Grand General for the Punitive Campaign against the Barbarians; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He served as his deputies, advancing north by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on the guisi day of the first month, Xu Da was appointed grand general for the northern expedition; Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He served as his deputies, each marching north by a separate route.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，追封郭子興滁陽王。

translations.literal: Second month, guiwei—Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the second month, Guo Zixing was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chuyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔求賢才可任六部者。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict sought men of talent suitable to serve in the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, an edict called for talented men fit to serve in the six ministries.

sentences.zh: 是月，李文忠下興和，進兵察罕腦兒，執元平章竹貞。

translations.literal: That month, Li Wenzhong subdued Xinghe, advanced to Chaghan-nur, and seized the Yuan Vice Councillor Zhu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Wenzhong took Xinghe, marched on Chaghan-nur, and captured the Yuan vice councillor Zhu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，免南畿、河南、山東、北平、浙東、江西廣信、饒州今年田租。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin—land rent was remitted for the Southern Capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhejiang, Guangxin in Jiangxi, and Raozhou for the current year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month, this year's land rent was remitted in the southern capital region, Henan, Shandong, Beiping, eastern Zhejiang, Guangxin in Jiangxi, and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，封皇子樉為秦王，棡晉王，棣燕王，橚吳王，楨楚王，榑齊王，梓潭王，杞趙王，檀魯王，從孫守謙靖江王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yichou—the princes were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Qin, Gang as Prince of Jin, Di as Prince of Yan, Su as Prince of Wu, Zhen as Prince of Chu, Fu as Prince of Qi, Zi as Prince of Tan, Qi as Prince of Zhao, Tan as Prince of Lu; and the collateral grandson Shouqian as Prince of Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month in summer, the imperial sons were enfeoffed: Shu as prince of Qin, Gang as prince of Jin, Di as prince of Yan, Su as prince of Wu, Zhen as prince of Chu, Fu as prince of Qi, Zi as prince of Tan, Qi as prince of Zhao, Tan as prince of Lu; the emperor's grandnephew Shouqian was made prince of Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 徐達大破擴廓帖木兒於沈兒峪，盡降其眾，擴廓走和林。

translations.literal: Xu Da inflicted a great defeat on Köke Temür at Shen'er Valley, causing all his troops to submit; Köke Temür fled to Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: At Shen'er Valley Xu Da routed Köke Temür, accepted the surrender of his entire army, and Köke Temür fled to Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，元帝崩於應昌，子愛猷識理達臘嗣。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang; his son Ayushiridara succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the Yuan emperor died at Yingchang and was succeeded by his son Ayushiridara.

sentences.zh: 是月，慈利土官覃垕作亂。

translations.literal: That month, the native official Tan Hu of Cili rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the tribal magistrate Tan Hu of Cili rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，徐達取興元。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jichou—Xu Da took Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the fifth month, Xu Da captured Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 分遣鄧愈招諭吐蕃。

translations.literal: Deng Yu was separately dispatched to summon and instruct the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu was sent separately to summon and win over the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔守令舉學識篤行之士。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict ordered magistrates to recommend men of solid learning and earnest conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict ordered local officials to recommend scholars of proven learning and upright character.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設科取士。

translations.literal: On jihai, the civil service examination was established to select scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the civil service examination was instituted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠克應昌。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Li Wenzhong took Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 元嗣君北走，獲其子買的裏八剌，降五萬餘人，窮追至北慶州，不及而還。

translations.literal: The Yuan successor fled north; his son Maidiribala was captured, more than fifty thousand submitted, and pursuit was pressed to North Qingzhou but could not overtake him and the force returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan heir fled north. His son Maidiribala was captured and more than fifty thousand men surrendered. Pursuit continued as far as northern Qingzhou, but they could not overtake him and turned back.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔行大射禮。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict ordered the great archery rite to be performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, an edict ordered observance of the great archery rite.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祀地於方丘，以仁祖配。

translations.literal: On wushen, sacrifice to Earth was performed at the square mound, with the Benevolent Ancestor as secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, sacrifice to Earth was offered at the square altar, with the Benevolent Ancestor as co-sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徐達下興元。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Xu Da subdued Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Xu Da captured Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 鄧愈克河州。

translations.literal: Deng Yu captured Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu took Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔開國時將帥無嗣者祿其家。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that families of founding generals who left no heirs should receive stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict provided stipends for the families of founding commanders who had left no male heir.

sentences.zh: 是月旱，齋戒，後妃親執爨，皇太子諸王饋於齋所。

translations.literal: That month there was drought; he fasted and purified himself; the empress and consorts personally tended the cooking fires; the crown prince and princes presented food at the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month drought struck. The emperor fasted and purified himself; empresses and consorts personally cooked at the hearth; the crown prince and princes brought offerings to the fasting lodge.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，素服草屨，步禱山川壇，露宿凡三日，還齋於西廡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuwu first day—in plain garments and straw sandals he walked to pray at the mountain and river altars, sleeping in the open for three days in all, then returned to fast in the western gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, the wuwu day, dressed in plain white and straw sandals, he walked to the mountain and river altars to pray, sleeping outdoors for three days before returning to continue his fast in the western gallery.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賚將士，省獄囚，命有司訪求通經術明治道者。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he rewarded the troops and reviewed prisoners in the jails; he ordered the relevant offices to seek out men versed in the classics, skilled in governance, and clear in principle.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, troops were rewarded and prisoners reviewed; officials were ordered to seek men learned in the classics, skilled in administration, and sound in principle.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大雨。

translations.literal: On renxu, great rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李文忠捷奏至，命仕元者勿賀。

translations.literal: On renshen, Li Wenzhong's victory memorial arrived; he ordered that those who had formerly served the Yuan should not offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Li Wenzhong's victory report arrived. The emperor ordered that former Yuan officials should not offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 諡元主曰順帝。

translations.literal: The Yuan ruler was given the posthumous title Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan emperor was posthumously titled Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，買的裏八剌至京師，群臣請獻俘。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Maidiribala reached the capital; the officials requested to present him as a captive.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Maidiribala arrived in the capital. Court officials asked to present him as a captive.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「武王伐殷用之乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When King Wu attacked Yin, did he use such a thing?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked, "Did King Wu use captives this way when he overthrew the Shang?"

sentences.zh: 」省臣以唐太宗嘗行之對。

translations.literal: The provincial officials answered that Emperor Taizong of Tang had once done so.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers cited Emperor Taizong of Tang, who had done so.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「太宗是待王世充耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "Taizong was dealing with Wang Shichong.

sentences.zh: 若遇隋之子孫，恐不爾也。

translations.literal: Had he encountered the descendants of Sui, he probably would not have acted thus."
translations.idiomatic: Had he faced the descendant of the Sui, I doubt he would have done the same."

sentences.zh: 」遂不許。

translations.literal: Thereupon he did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 又以捷奏多侈辭，謂宰相曰：「元主中國百年，朕與卿等父母皆賴其生養，奈何為此浮薄之言？

translations.literal: Again, because the victory memorial used much extravagant language, he said to the chancellor: "The Yuan ruled China for a century; my parents and yours all relied on them for life and nurture—how can you use such shallow, frivolous words?
translations.idiomatic: Finding the victory memorial full of boastful language, he told the chancellor: "The Yuan ruled China for a century. Our parents all lived under their rule—how can you write such unworthy triumphalism?

sentences.zh: 亟改之。

translations.literal: Change it at once."
translations.idiomatic: Change it at once."

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，封買的裏八剌為崇禮侯。

translations.literal: On yihai, Maidiribala was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Maidiribala was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chongli.

sentences.zh: 丙子，告捷於南郊。

translations.literal: On bingzi, victory was announced at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, victory was reported at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，告太廟，詔示天下。

translations.literal: On dingchou, it was announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict was displayed to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, victory was announced at the imperial ancestral temple and an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徙蘇州、松江、嘉興、湖州、杭州民無業者田臨濠，給資糧牛種，復三年。

translations.literal: On xinsi, unemployed commoners from Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were relocated to farm at Linhao; provisions, grain, oxen, and seed were supplied, and taxes were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, idle residents of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Hangzhou were resettled on farmland at Linhao, given grain, oxen, and seed, and granted three years' tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 是月，倭寇山東、浙江、福建濱海州縣。

translations.literal: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Japanese pirates raided coastal prefectures and counties in Shandong, Zhejiang, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，明昇將吳友仁寇漢中，參政傅友德擊卻之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingchen—Ming Sheng's general Wu Youren raided Hanzhong; Vice Councillor Fu Youde repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the seventh month in autumn, Wu Youren, a general of Ming Sheng, raided Hanzhong and Vice Councillor Fu Youde drove him back.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞楊憲有罪誅。

translations.literal: Left Vice Grand Councillor Yang Xian was executed for crime.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice grand councillor Yang Xian was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，遣使瘞中原遺骸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yiyou—envoys were dispatched to bury the scattered bones of the Central Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the eighth month, envoys were sent to inter the unburied dead of the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，詔儒士更直午門，為武臣講經史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingchen—an edict ordered Confucian scholars to rotate duty at the Meridian Gate and lecture military officials on the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the tenth month in winter, an edict ordered scholars to take turns at the Meridian Gate lecturing military officers on the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，周德興為征南將軍，討覃垕，垕遁。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhou Dexing was made Southern Campaign General to suppress Tan Hu; Tan Hu fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Zhou Dexing was appointed southern campaign general to suppress Tan Hu, who fled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On xinsi, a letter was presented to the Yuan successor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, a letter was sent to the Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，北征師還。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renchen—the northern expedition army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the northern expeditionary army returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，告武成於郊廟。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he announced the completion of martial achievements at the suburban temples.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the emperor reported the fulfillment of his military mandate at the suburban altars.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大封功臣。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he greatly enfeoffed meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, founding ministers received lavish enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 進李善長韓國公，徐達魏國公，封李文忠曹國公，馮勝宋國公，鄧愈衛國公，常遇春子茂鄭國公，湯和等侯者二十八人。

translations.literal: Li Shanchang was advanced to Duke of Han, Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong was enfeoffed Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He and twenty-eight others were made marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanchang was promoted to Duke of Han and Xu Da to Duke of Wei; Li Wenzhong became Duke of Cao, Feng Sheng Duke of Song, Deng Yu Duke of Wei, Chang Yuchun's son Mao Duke of Zheng, and Tang He together with twenty-eight others were created marquises.

sentences.zh: 己亥，設壇親祭戰沒將士。

translations.literal: On jihai, an altar was set up and he personally sacrificed to officers who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, he erected an altar and offered sacrifice in person to the generals fallen in war.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he performed the rites at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, he conducted the suburban sacrifice at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔戶部置戶籍、戶帖，歲計登耗以聞，著為令。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict ordered the Board of Revenue to establish household registers and household certificates; annual tallies of increase and decrease were to be reported, and this was enacted as a permanent statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, an edict directed the Board of Revenue to institute household registers and household certificates, with yearly accounts of gains and losses reported to the throne and codified as standing law.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封中書右丞汪廣洋忠勤伯，御史中丞劉基誠意伯。

translations.literal: On yimao, Right Vice Grand Councillor Wang Guangyang was enfeoffed as Count of Zhongqin, and Censor-in-Chief Liu Ji as Count of Chengyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Wang Guangyang, right vice grand councillor, was created Count of Zhongqin, and Liu Ji, censor-in-chief, Count of Chengyi.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，復貽元嗣君書，並諭和林諸部。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guihai—he again sent a letter to the Yuan heir and likewise instructed the various departments of Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guihai day, he again wrote to the Yuan successor and issued instructions to the Karakorum tribes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，建奉先殿。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Hall for Venerating the Ancestors was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Hall for Venerating the Ancestors was erected.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使祭歷代帝王陵寢，並加修葺。

translations.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mausoleums of emperors of successive dynasties, and repairs were added.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the tombs of former emperors and to undertake their restoration.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜勳臣田。

translations.literal: On jimao, fields were granted to meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, land grants were bestowed on the founding ministers.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以正月至是月，日中屢有黑子，詔廷臣言得失。

translations.literal: On renwu, because from the first month to this month black spots had repeatedly appeared on the sun at midday, he edicted the court ministers to speak on what was right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, noting that sunspots had appeared repeatedly at noon from the first month onward, he ordered the court to deliberate on the empire's merits and failings.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、西洋入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Champa, Java, and the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙戌，李善長罷，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, bingxu—Li Shanchang was dismissed, and Wang Guangyang became Right Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on the bingxu day of the first month, Li Shanchang was removed from office and Wang Guangyang appointed right grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中山侯湯和為征西將軍，江夏侯周德興、德慶侯廖永忠副之，率舟師由瞿塘，潁川侯傅友德為征虜前將軍，濟甯侯顧時副之，率步騎由秦隴伐蜀。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhongshan Marquis Tang He was made Campaigning West General, with Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing and Deqing Marquis Liao Yongzhong as his deputies, leading the fleet through Qutang; Yingchuan Marquis Fu Youde was made Forward Campaigning General against the Barbarians, with Jining Marquis Gu Shi as deputy, leading infantry and cavalry through Qin and Long to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, was named campaigning west general, with Zhou Dexing of Jiangxia and Liao Yongzhong of Deqing as his lieutenants, to lead the fleet through Qutang Gorge; Fu Youde of Yingchuan was made forward campaigning general against the barbarians, with Gu Shi of Jining as his second, to march infantry and cavalry through Qinlong into Shu.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐達練兵北平。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Da trained troops at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da, Duke of Wei, drilled troops at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，衛國公鄧愈督餉給征蜀軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Duke of Wei Deng Yu supervised provisions for the army campaigning in Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, took charge of supplying the Shu expedition.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，建郊廟於中都。

translations.literal: On gengyin, suburban temples were built at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, suburban altars were established at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔設科取士，連舉三年，嗣後三年一舉。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict established the civil-service examinations, to be held three years in succession, and thereafter once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, an edict instituted the civil examinations, to be held annually for three years and thereafter once every three years.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免山西旱災田租。

translations.literal: On wushen, land tax was remitted for drought-stricken fields in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, grain rents were waived on drought-afflicted lands in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，幸中都。

translations.literal: Second month, jiaxu—he visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiaxu day, the emperor traveled to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自中都。

translations.literal: On renwu, he returned from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, he returned from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 元平章劉益以遼東降。

translations.literal: Yuan Pingzhang Liu Yi surrendered Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi, Yuan director of the Secretariat, surrendered Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲太平、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax was remitted for Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: That month, grain rents were waived in Taiping, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，始策試天下貢士，賜吳伯宗等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, yiyou, first day of the month—for the first time the empire's presented scholars were examined by policy questions; Wu Bozong and others were granted jinshi with honors and lower degrees in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, yiyou, the inaugural palace examination was held for scholars sent up from the provinces; Wu Bozong and others received the jinshi degree with distinction, and lesser ranks were awarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徙山後民萬七千戶屯北平。

translations.literal: On yisi, seventeen thousand households of people from beyond the mountains were moved to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, seventeen thousand mountain-border households were resettled to colonize Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丁未，誠意伯劉基致仕。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Count of Chengyi Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Liu Ji, Count of Chengyi, resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，傅友德克階州，文、隆、綿三州相繼下。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingxu—Fu Youde captured Jie Prefecture, and Wen, Long, and Mian prefectures fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingxu day, Fu Youde took Jiezhou, and Wen, Long, and Mian followed in quick succession.

sentences.zh: 五月，免江西、浙江秋糧。

translations.literal: Fifth month—autumn grain tax was remitted for Jiangxi and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, autumn grain levies were waived in Jiangxi and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，傅友德克漢州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu—Fu Youde captured Han Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, Fu Youde seized Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廖永忠克夔州。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Liao Yongzhong captured Kui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Liao Yongzhong took Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，明昇將丁世貞破文州，守將硃顯忠死之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Ming Sheng's general Ding Shizhen defeated Wen Prefecture; the defending officer Zhu Xiangu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Ding Shizhen, a general of Ming Sheng, stormed Wenzhou; the defender Zhu Xiangu was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，湯和至重慶，明昇降。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tang He reached Chongqing and Ming Sheng surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Tang He arrived at Chongqing and Ming Sheng submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，倭寇膠州。

translations.literal: On wushen, Japanese pirates raided Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Japanese raiders struck Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，徙山後民三萬五千戶於內地，又徙沙漠遺民三萬二千戶屯田北平。

translations.literal: That month, thirty-five thousand households from beyond the mountains were moved to the interior, and thirty-two thousand desert remnant people were also moved to farm garrison lands at Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thirty-five thousand mountain-border households were relocated inland, and thirty-two thousand desert refugees were settled on garrison farms around Beiping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，徐達練兵山西。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinhai—Xu Da trained troops in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, Xu Da drilled troops in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，傅友德下成都，四川平。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Fu Youde took Chengdu and Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Fu Youde entered Chengdu and Sichuan was brought to heel.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，明昇至京師，封歸義侯。

translations.literal: On yichou, Ming Sheng reached the capital and was enfeoffed Marquis of Returning Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Ming Sheng arrived at the capital and was created Marquis of Returning Allegiance.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，免中都、淮、揚及泰、滁、無為田租。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu—land tax was remitted for the Central Capital, Huai, Yang, and Tai, Chu, and Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiawu day, grain rents were waived in the Central Capital, along the Huai and Yangzi, and in Tai, Chu, and Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On jiyou, famine relief was distributed in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, grain was issued to relieve famine in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，高州海寇亂，通判王名善死之。

translations.literal: That month, sea bandits rose in disorder in Gaozhou; Assistant Prefect Wang Mingshan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: That month, pirates ravaged the Gaozhou coast; Vice Magistrate Wang Mingshan was killed resisting them.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengxu, first day of the month—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, gengxu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，征蜀師還。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen—the army that had campaigned in Shu returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingshen day, the Shu expedition marched home.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen—he performed the rites at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingchen day, he conducted the suburban sacrifice at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命官吏犯贓者罪勿貸。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he ordered that officials guilty of corruption should receive no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict declared that corrupt officials would not be spared punishment.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西、河南被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken fields in Shaanxi and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, grain rents were waived on lands stricken by disaster in Shaanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，徐達還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month—Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Xu Da came back to court.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、浡泥、高麗、三佛齊、暹羅、日本、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribute missions arrived from Annam, Poni, Goryeo, Sanfoqi, Siam, Japan, and Zhenla.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸丑，待制王禕使雲南，詔諭元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, guichou—Academician Wang Wei was sent as envoy to Yunnan to instruct the Yuan Prince of Liang, Basalawarmi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on the guichou day of the first month, Academician Wang Wei was dispatched to Yunnan with an edict for the Yuan Prince of Liang, Basalawarmi.

sentences.zh: 禕至，不屈死。

translations.literal: When Wei arrived, he refused to submit and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Wei reached Yunnan, refused to yield, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，徙陳理、明升於高麗。

translations.literal: On yichou, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were moved to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Chen Li and Ming Sheng were exiled to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏國公徐達為征虜大將軍，出雁門，趨和林，曹國公李文忠為左副將軍，出應昌，宋國公馮勝為征西將軍，取甘肅，征擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Duke of Wei Xu Da was made Grand Campaigning General against the Barbarians, marching out of Yanmen toward Karakorum; Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong was Left Deputy General, marching out of Yingchang; Duke of Song Feng Sheng was Campaigning West General, taking Gansu to campaign against Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Xu Da, Duke of Wei, was appointed grand campaigning general against the barbarians and advanced through Yanmen toward Karakorum; Li Wenzhong, Duke of Cao, served as left deputy general and marched from Yingchang; Feng Sheng, Duke of Song, was made campaigning west general to seize Gansu and pursue Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎督海運，餉遼東。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pacifying the Seas Wu Zhen supervised sea transport to provision Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen, Marquis of Pacifying the Seas, oversaw maritime grain shipments to supply Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 衛國公鄧愈為征南將軍，江夏侯周德興、江陰侯吳良副之，分道討湖南、廣西洞蠻。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Deng Yu was Campaigning South General, with Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing and Jiangyin Marquis Wu Liang as deputies, advancing by separate routes to subdue the cave barbarians of Hunan and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, was named campaigning south general, with Zhou Dexing of Jiangxia and Wu Liang of Jiangyin as his lieutenants, to strike the cave tribes of Hunan and Guangxi by divergent routes.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，安南陳叔明弒其主日熞自立，遣使入貢，卻之。

translations.literal: Second month, bingxu—Chen Shuming of Annam murdered his lord Ri Jie and installed himself, sending envoys with tribute; the tribute was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingxu day, Chen Shuming of Annam assassinated his ruler Ri Jie and seized the throne, then sent tribute; the court declined it.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，都督僉事藍玉敗擴廓於土剌河。

translations.literal: Third month, dingmao—Regional Commander Lan Yu defeated Köke Temür on the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingmao day, Regional Commander Lan Yu routed Köke Temür on the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振濟南、萊州饑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao—famine relief was distributed in Jinan and Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jimao day, grain was issued to relieve famine in Jinan and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始行鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the village drinking ceremony was instituted for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the communal village drinking rite was introduced.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈平散毛諸洞蠻。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu pacified the cave barbarians of Sanmao and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu subdued the Sanmao cave tribes and their neighbors.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，徐達及元兵戰於嶺北，敗績。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renzi—Xu Da fought the Yuan army north of the mountains and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renzi day, Xu Da engaged the Yuan forces north of the steppe and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔曰：「天下大定，禮儀風俗不可不正。

translations.literal: That month, an edict said: "All-under-Heaven is greatly settled; rites and customs cannot but be set right.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict proclaimed: "The realm is at last united; ritual and custom must be brought into order.

sentences.zh: 諸遭亂為人奴隸者復為民。

translations.literal: All who became slaves amid the disorders shall again be made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: All who were enslaved during the wars shall be restored to free status.

sentences.zh: 凍餒者里中富室假貸之，孤寡殘疾者官養之，毋失所。

translations.literal: Those suffering cold and hunger shall be lent to by wealthy households in the hamlet; orphans, widows, and the disabled shall be supported by the state, that none be left without refuge.
translations.idiomatic: The cold and hungry shall receive loans from prosperous neighbors; orphans, widows, and the infirm shall be maintained by the state, so that none lack a home.

sentences.zh: 鄉黨論齒，相見揖拜，毋違禮。

translations.literal: In village associations, seniority by age shall be observed; on meeting, bow and salute, and do not violate ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In every community, age shall govern precedence; neighbors shall greet one another with due ceremony and not depart from propriety.

sentences.zh: 婚姻毋論財。

translations.literal: In marriage, do not bargain over wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Marriage shall not be made a matter of price.

sentences.zh: 喪事稱家有無，毋惑陰陽拘忌，停柩暴露。

translations.literal: In funerals, act according to what the household possesses; do not be deluded by yin-yang taboos, leaving coffins exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Funerals shall suit a family's means; no one shall be swayed by geomantic superstition to leave coffins unburied and exposed.

sentences.zh: 流民復業者各就丁力耕種，毋以舊田為限。

translations.literal: Returning refugees who resume livelihood shall each cultivate according to their laboring strength, without being limited by their former fields.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees who return to farming may till according to their strength, without being bound to their old holdings alone.

sentences.zh: 僧道齋醮雜男女，恣飲食，有司嚴治之。

translations.literal: Buddhist and Daoist fasting rituals that mix men and women and indulge in feasting—the responsible offices shall punish them severely.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist and Daoist rites that mingle the sexes and end in revelry shall be rigorously suppressed by local authorities.

sentences.zh: 閩、粵豪家毋閹人子為火者，犯者抵罪。

translations.literal: Great families of Fujian and Guangdong must not castrate their sons to serve as fire-tenders; violators shall be punished according to law."
translations.idiomatic: Great houses in Fujian and Guangdong must not castrate their sons for service as household eunuchs; offenders shall be punished to the full extent of the law."

sentences.zh: 」六月丙子，定宦官禁令。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingzi—the prohibitions on eunuchs were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, regulations governing eunuchs were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定宮官女職之制。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the regulations for palace women and their offices were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the ranks and duties of palace women were codified.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，馮勝克甘肅，追敗元兵於瓜、沙州。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Feng Sheng captured Gansu and pursued, defeating the Yuan army at Guazhou and Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Feng Sheng took Gansu and, in pursuit, routed the Yuan forces at Guazhou and Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，定六部職掌及歲終考績法。

translations.literal: On guisi, the duties of the Six Ministries and the law for year-end performance review were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the responsibilities of the Six Ministries and the rules for annual evaluation were established.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吳良平靖州蠻。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Wu Liang pacified the tribes of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李文忠敗元兵於阿魯渾河，宣甯侯曹良臣戰沒。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Wenzhong defeated the Yuan army on the Aru Hun River; Marquis of Xuanning Cao Liangchen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Li Wenzhong routed the Yuan army on the Aru Hun River; Cao Liangchen, Marquis of Xuanning, fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作鐵榜誡功臣。

translations.literal: On yisi, the iron tablet admonishing meritorious officials was made.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the iron inscription warning meritorious ministers against treason was cast.

sentences.zh: 是月，振山東饑，免被災郡縣田租。

translations.literal: That month, famine relief was distributed in Shandong, and land tax was remitted for disaster-stricken prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: That month, grain was issued to relieve famine in Shandong, and rents were waived in stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，湯和及元兵戰於斷頭山，敗績。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingchen—Tang He fought the Yuan army at Broken-Head Mountain and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingchen day, Tang He engaged the Yuan at Broken-Head Mountain and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，吳良平五開、古州諸蠻。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingshen—Wu Liang pacified the barbarians of Wukai, Guzhou, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingshen day, Wu Liang subdued the tribes of Wukai, Guzhou, and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，元兵犯雲內，同知黃里死之。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Yuan army invaded Yunnei; Vice Commissioner Huang Li died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Yuan forces raided Yunnei; Vice Commissioner Huang Li was killed defending it.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，周德興平婪鳳、安田諸蠻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuwu—Zhou Dexing pacified the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuwu day, Zhou Dexing pacified the Lanfeng, Antian, and related tribes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，馮勝師還。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingyou—Feng Sheng's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingyou day, Feng Sheng's expedition marched home.

sentences.zh: 是月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: That month, grain rents were waived in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinyou—he performed the rites at the Circular Mound.
