translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinyou day, he conducted the suburban sacrifice at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 甲子，征南師還。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the army campaigning in the south returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the southern expedition returned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，納哈出犯遼東。

translations.literal: On renshen, Naghachu invaded Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Naghachu raided Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是月，召徐達、李文忠還。

translations.literal: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xu Da and Li Wenzhong were summoned back.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔以農桑學校課有司。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu—an edict made agriculture, sericulture, and schools the measure by which officials were judged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, an edict held local officials accountable for promoting farming, silk production, and schools.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命百官奏事啟皇太子。

translations.literal: On xinsi, all officials presenting memorials were ordered to report first to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, officials were required to submit memorials to the crown prince before the throne.

sentences.zh: 庚子，鄧愈為征西將軍，征吐番。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Deng Yu was made Campaigning West General to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Deng Yu was appointed campaigning west general to march against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貽元嗣君書。

translations.literal: On renyin, a letter was sent to the Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, another letter was dispatched to the Yuan successor.

sentences.zh: 是年，瑣里、占城、高麗、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Suoli, Champa, Goryeo, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢使再至，諭自後三年一貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo's tribute envoys came twice; they were instructed that thereafter tribute should be sent once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent tribute twice; the court directed that future missions should come only once every three years.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲寅，謫汪廣洋為廣東參政。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, jiayin—Wang Guangyang was demoted to Administrator of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on the jiayin day of the first month, Wang Guangyang was demoted to administrator of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，諭暫罷科舉，察舉賢才。

translations.literal: Second month, yiwei—an edict ordered the civil examinations temporarily suspended and worthy men to be recommended and selected.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiwei day, an edict suspended the civil examinations for the time being and called for the recommendation of worthy men.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命御史及按察使考察有司。

translations.literal: On renyin, censors and surveillance commissioners were ordered to investigate local officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, censors and provincial surveillance commissioners were charged with inspecting local magistrates.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, guimao, first day of the month—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, guimao, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 頒《昭鑒錄》，訓誡諸王。

translations.literal: The Bright Mirror Record was promulgated to admonish the various princes.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Mirror Record was issued as instruction to the imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太閱。

translations.literal: On wushen, a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the emperor held a grand review of the troops.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐達為征虜大將軍，李文忠、馮勝、鄧愈、湯和副之，備邊山西、北平。

translations.literal: On renzi, Xu Da was made Grand Campaigning General against the Barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as deputies, to guard the borders of Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Xu Da was appointed grand campaigning general against the barbarians, with Li Wenzhong, Feng Sheng, Deng Yu, and Tang He as his lieutenants, to secure the frontiers of Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，指揮使於顯為總兵官，備倭。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Commander Yu Xian was made supreme commander to guard against the Japanese.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Commander Yu Xian was appointed supreme commander to defend against Japanese raiders.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，令有司上山川險易圖。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou—the responsible offices were ordered to submit maps of terrain, difficult and easy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, local authorities were ordered to submit maps of difficult and easy terrain.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，盱眙獻瑞麥，薦宗廟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu—Xuyi presented auspicious wheat and offered it at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, Xuyi presented auspicious wheat, which was offered at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，擴廓帖木兒遣兵攻雁門，指揮吳均擊卻之。

translations.literal: On renchen, Köke Temür dispatched troops to attack Yanmen; Commander Wu Jun repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Köke Temür sent troops against Yanmen Pass; Commander Wu Jun drove them back.

sentences.zh: 是月，免北平、河間、河南、開封、延安、汾州被災田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted on fields stricken by disaster in Beiping, Hejian, Henan, Kaifeng, Yan'an, and Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，命戶部稽渡江以來各省水旱災傷分數，優恤之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renyin—the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to audit the extent of flood and drought damage in each province since the crossing of the river, and extend favorable relief.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the renyin day, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to tally flood and drought losses in each province since the Yangzi crossing and extend preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，胡惟庸為右丞相，八月乙亥，詔祀三皇及歷代帝王。

translations.literal: On renzi, Hu Weiyong became Right Grand Councillor. Eighth month, yihai—an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and successive emperors.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Hu Weiyong was named right grand councillor. In the eighth month, on the yihai day, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns and to successive dynastic founders.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，召徐達、馮勝還。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinsi—Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinsi day, Xu Da and Feng Sheng were recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，擴廓帖木兒犯大同，徐達遣將擊敗之，達仍留鎮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renzi—Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da dispatched generals to defeat him, and Xu remained to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renzi day, Köke Temür invaded Datong; Xu Da sent generals who defeated him, and Xu himself remained on garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣兵部尚書劉仁振真定饑。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Minister of War Liu Ren was dispatched to relieve famine in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Minister of War Liu Ren was sent to relieve famine in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，冬至，帝不豫，改卜郊。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the winter solstice—the emperor was unwell and rescheduled the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the winter solstice, the emperor fell ill and postponed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，錄故功臣子孫未嗣者二百九人。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, yihai—two hundred nine descendants of former meritorious officials who had not yet received succession honors were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the yihai day, two hundred nine descendants of meritorious officials who had not yet received hereditary honors were entered on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On renwu, rites were performed at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，頒定《大明律》。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Great Ming Code was promulgated in fixed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the Great Ming Code was issued in its definitive form.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、高麗、占城、真臘、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Korea, Champa, Cambodia, and Srivijaya presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Siam, Korea, Champa, Cambodia, and Srivijaya.

sentences.zh: 命安南陳叔明權知國事。

translations.literal: Chen Shuming of Annam was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuming of Annam was authorized to govern the realm on a provisional basis.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，都督僉事王簡、王誠、平章李伯升屯田河南、山東、北平。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, jiaxu—Assistant Chief Commanders Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Vice Minister Li Bosheng garrisoned and farmed in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on the jiaxu day of the first month, Assistant Chief Commanders Wang Jian and Wang Cheng and Vice Minister Li Bosheng were stationed to farm garrison lands in Henan, Shandong, and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 靖海侯吳禎為總兵官，都督於顯副之，巡海捕倭。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pacifying the Sea Wu Zhen was made supreme commander, with Chief Commander Yu Xian as deputy, to patrol the seas and capture Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen, Marquis of Pacifying the Sea, was appointed supreme commander, with Chief Commander Yu Xian as his deputy, to patrol the coast and hunt Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, dingyou new moon—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the dingyou day in the second month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，修曲阜孔子廟，設孔、顏、孟三氏學。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Confucius Temple in Qufu was repaired, and schools for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the Confucius Temple in Qufu was restored, and schools were established for the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans.

sentences.zh: 是月，平陽、太原、汾州、曆城、汲縣旱蝗，並免租稅。

translations.literal: That month, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian suffered drought and locusts; land tax was remitted in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought and locusts struck Pingyang, Taiyuan, Fenzhou, Licheng, and Jixian; land tax was remitted throughout the affected region.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，都督藍玉敗元兵於白酒泉，遂拔興和。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai—Chief Commander Lan Yu defeated Yuan troops at Baijiu Spring and then took Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jihai day, Chief Commander Lan Yu routed Yuan forces at Baijiu Spring and then captured Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金吾指揮陸齡討永、道諸州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: On renyin, Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling campaigned against the barbarians of Yong and Dao prefectures and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Golden Guard Commander Lu Ling campaigned against the tribal peoples of Yong and Dao prefectures and brought them to submission.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，免真定等四十二禕府州縣被災田租。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingzi—land tax on disaster-stricken fields in forty-two prefectures and counties including Zhending was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, land tax was remitted on disaster-stricken fields in forty-two prefectures and counties, including Zhending.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，振蘇州饑民三十萬戶。

translations.literal: On xinsi, three hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Suzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, relief was extended to three hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，減蘇、松、嘉、湖極重田租之半。

translations.literal: On guisi, the extremely heavy land tax in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the crushing land tax in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was cut by half.

sentences.zh: 六月，陝西平涼、延安、靖寧、鄜州雨雹，山西、山東、北平、河南蝗，並蠲田租。

translations.literal: Sixth month—Pingliang, Yan'an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi were struck by hail; Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan by locusts; land tax was remitted in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, hail struck Pingliang, Yan'an, Jingning, and Fuzhou in Shaanxi, while locusts ravaged Shanxi, Shandong, Beiping, and Henan; land tax was remitted throughout.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，李文忠破元兵於大寧、高州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiazi—Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan troops at Daining and Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the jiazi day, Li Wenzhong defeated Yuan forces at Daining and Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，倭寇登、萊。

translations.literal: On renshen, Japanese pirates raided Deng and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Japanese pirates raided Dengzhou and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，祀歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu new moon—sacrifice was performed at the Temple of Successive Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the jiawu day in the eighth month, sacrifice was offered at the Temple of Successive Emperors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔軍士陣歿父母妻子不能自存者，官為存養。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict said: where soldiers fell in battle and their parents, wives, and children could not support themselves, the state shall maintain them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, an edict declared that when soldiers died in battle and their families could not support themselves, the state would provide for them.

sentences.zh: 百姓避兵離散或客死，遺老幼，並資遣還。

translations.literal: Where common people fled war and scattered, or died away from home leaving the old and young behind, all were given funds and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Civilians displaced by war, or those who died far from home leaving elderly kin and children behind, were all given travel funds and escorted home.

sentences.zh: 遠宦卒官，妻子不能歸者，有司給舟車資送。

translations.literal: Where officials died in office in distant posts and their wives and children could not return, the responsible offices were to provide boats, carts, and travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: When officials died in distant posts and their families could not afford the journey home, local authorities were to provide boats, carts, and travel expenses.

sentences.zh: 庚申，振河間、廣平、順德、真定饑，蠲租稅。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending were relieved of famine; rent and tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, famine relief was extended to Hejian, Guangping, Shunde, and Zhending, and rent and tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，遣崇禮侯買的裏八剌歸，遺元嗣君書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingchou—the Honored Marquis Maidiliba'er was sent home, with a letter left for the Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingchou day, the Honored Marquis Maidiliba'er was sent home to the north, bearing a letter for the Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬戌，納哈出犯遼陽，千戶吳壽擊走之。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, renxu—Naghachu invaded Liaoyang; Battalion Commander Wu Shou drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the renxu day, Naghachu invaded Liaoyang; Battalion Commander Wu Shou repelled him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有事於圜丘。

translations.literal: On xinwei, rites were performed at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，召鄧愈、湯和還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu—Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day, Deng Yu and Tang He were recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 是年，阿難功德國、暹羅、琉球、三佛齊、烏斯藏、撒裏、畏兀兒入貢。

translations.literal: That year, A-nan Gongde, Siam, Ryukyu, Srivijaya, U-Tsang, Sarir, and the Uighurs presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from A-nan Gongde, Siam, Ryukyu, Srivijaya, U-Tsang, Sarir, and the Uighur lands.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月辛未，增祀雞籠山功臣廟一百八人。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, xinwei—one hundred eight more men were added to the Meritorious Officials Temple on Jilong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year, on the xinwei day of the first month, one hundred eight more names were added to the Meritorious Officials Temple on Jilong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命有司察窮民無告者，給屋舍衣食。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the responsible offices were ordered to investigate destitute people with no one to plead for them and provide housing, food, and clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, local authorities were ordered to find the destitute who had no one to speak for them and provide housing, food, and clothing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鄧愈、湯和等十三人屯戍北平、陝西、河南。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Deng Yu, Tang He, and twelve others garrisoned Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Deng Yu, Tang He, and twelve other commanders took up garrison duty in Beiping, Shaanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔天下立社學。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered village schools established throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict ordered community schools established throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決開封，發民夫塞之。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng; corvée labor was mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Yellow River broke through at Kaifeng; corvée laborers were mobilized to stem the flood.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，宥雜犯死罪以下及官犯私罪者，謫鳳陽輸作屯種贖罪。

translations.literal: Second month, jiawu—those guilty of miscellaneous crimes below death and officials guilty of private offenses were pardoned and exiled to Fengyang to perform labor and farm garrison fields in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiawu day, those convicted of lesser capital crimes and officials guilty of private offenses were pardoned and sent to Fengyang to labor and farm in settlement of their guilt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On guichou, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 召徐達、李文忠、馮勝還，傅友德等留鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled; Fu Youde and others remained to garrison Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng were recalled to court; Fu Youde and others remained to guard Beiping.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，立鈔法。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou—the paper currency law was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, the paper currency system was established by law.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷寶源局鑄錢。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Baoyuan Bureau's coin minting was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Baoyuan Bureau ceased minting copper coin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，幸中都。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao—the emperor visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, the emperor traveled to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至自中都。

translations.literal: On dingsi, he returned from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, he returned from the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 免彰德、大名、臨洮、平涼、河州被災田租。

translations.literal: Land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was remitted on disaster-stricken fields in Zhangde, Daming, Lintao, Pingliang, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 罷營中都。

translations.literal: Construction of the Central Capital was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Work on the Central Capital was suspended.

sentences.zh: 致仕誠意怕劉基卒。

translations.literal: The retired Lord of Sincerity Liu Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, Lord of Sincerity, who had retired from office, died.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，永嘉候硃亮祖偕傅友德鎮北平。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jisi—Marquis of Yongjia Zhu Liangzu joined Fu Youde in garrisoning Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jisi day, Zhu Liangzu, Marquis of Yongjia, joined Fu Youde in guarding Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，指揮同知胡汝平貴州蠻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renyin—Assistant Commander Hu Ruping pacified the Guizhou barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, Assistant Commander Hu Ruping pacified the tribal peoples of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiwei new moon—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the new moon of the jiwei day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改作太廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Grand Ancestral Temple was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Grand Ancestral Temple was reconstructed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召傅友德、硃亮祖還，李文忠、顧時鎮山西、北平。

translations.literal: On renxu, Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled; Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi garrisoned Shanxi and Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Fu Youde and Zhu Liangzu were recalled; Li Wenzhong and Gu Shi took up garrison duty in Shanxi and Beiping.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔百官奔父母喪不俟報。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict said officials need not await permission when rushing home for a parent's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, an edict declared that officials need not await imperial leave to mourn a parent.

sentences.zh: 京師地震。

translations.literal: The capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免應天、太平、甯國鎮江及蘄、黃諸府被災田租。

translations.literal: On dingchou, land tax on disaster-stricken fields in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the Qi and Huang prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, land tax was remitted on disaster-stricken fields in Yingtian, Taiping, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, and the Qi and Huang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，元擴廓帖木兒卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou—the Yuan Köke Temür died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, Köke Temür of the Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，詔舉富民素行端潔達時務者。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dinghai—an edict ordered recommendation of wealthy men whose conduct was upright and pure and who understood the affairs of the age.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dinghai day, an edict called for the recommendation of prosperous men of upright character who understood public affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命皇太子諸王講武中都。

translations.literal: On renzi, the crown prince and the princes were ordered to drill troops at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the crown prince and the imperial princes were ordered to conduct military exercises at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingchou—rites were performed at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingchou day, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，京師地震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuzi—the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuzi day, another earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使振蘇州、湖州、嘉興、松江、常州、太平、甯國、杭州水災。

translations.literal: On jiayin, envoys were dispatched to relieve flood disaster in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, commissioners were sent to relieve flooding in Suzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taiping, Ningguo, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，納哈出犯遼東，指揮馬雲、葉旺大敗之。

translations.literal: That month, Naghachu invaded Liaodong; Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang inflicted a great defeat on him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Naghachu invaded Liaodong; Commanders Ma Yun and Ye Wang routed his forces.

sentences.zh: 是年，撒裏、高麗、占城、暹羅、日本、爪哇、三佛齊入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Sarir, Korea, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Srivijaya presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Sarir, Korea, Champa, Siam, Japan, Java, and Srivijaya.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，中山侯湯和，潁川侯傅友德，都督僉事藍玉、王弼，中書右丞丁玉，備邊延安。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month—Marquis of Zhongshan Tang He, Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde, Assistant Chief Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Vice Minister Ding Yu prepared the border at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year, in the first month, Tang He, Marquis of Zhongshan, Fu Youde, Marquis of Yingchuan, Assistant Chief Commanders Lan Yu and Wang Bi, and Vice Minister Ding Yu took up frontier defense at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，詔曰：「比年西征燉煌，北伐沙漠，軍需甲仗，皆資山、陝，又以秦、晉二府宮殿之役，重困吾民。

translations.literal: Third month, jimao—an edict said: "In recent years the western campaign to Dunhuang and the northern expedition into the desert have drawn military supplies and armor chiefly from Shanxi and Shaanxi; moreover the palace construction of the Qin and Jin princedoms has heavily burdened our people."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jimao day, an edict declared: "Recent western campaigns to Dunhuang and northern expeditions into the desert have drained Shanxi and Shaanxi for arms and provisions; the palace works of the Qin and Jin princedoms have weighed still more heavily on the people."

sentences.zh: 平定以來，閭閻未息。

translations.literal: "Since pacification, households have not rested."
translations.idiomatic: "Since the realm was pacified, the common people have known no respite."

sentences.zh: 國都始建，土木屢興。

translations.literal: "With the founding of the capital, construction has repeatedly arisen."
translations.idiomatic: "With the founding of the capital, building projects have arisen again and again."

sentences.zh: 畿輔既極煩勞，外郡疲於轉運。

translations.literal: "The core provinces have been taxed to exhaustion, and outer commanderies worn down by transport."
translations.idiomatic: "The heartland has been driven to exhaustion, and outer provinces worn down by transport duties."

sentences.zh: 今蓄儲有餘，其淮、揚、安、徽、池五府及山西、陝西、河南、福建、江西、浙江、北平、湖廣今年租賦，悉免之。」

translations.literal: "Now stores are ample; Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chizhou five prefectures, together with Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang—this year's rent and tax are all remitted."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the granaries are full. This year's rent and tax are remitted for the five prefectures of Huai, Yang, An, Hui, and Chizhou, and for Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Fujian, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Beiping, and Huguang."

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，京師自去年八月不雨，是日始雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengxu—from the eighth month of last year the capital had had no rain; on this day rain began.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengxu day, rain fell at last on the capital, which had gone without rain since the eighth month of the previous year.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，自庚戌雨，至是日始霽。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guiyou—from the gengxu day it had rained; on this day it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, the skies cleared after continuous rain since the gengxu day.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，改行中書省為承宣佈政使司。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiawu—the Branch Secretariat was renamed the Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, the Branch Secretariat was renamed the Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李文忠還。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Li Wenzhong returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Li Wenzhong returned to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guichou new moon—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the new moon of the guichou day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲蘇、松、嘉、湖水災田租，振永平旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood-stricken land tax in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was remitted, and Yongping was relieved of drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted on flood-stricken fields in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, and drought relief was extended to Yongping.

sentences.zh: 元將伯顏帖木兒犯延安，傅友德敗降之。

translations.literal: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan'an; Fu Youde defeated and accepted his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan general Bayan Temür invaded Yan'an; Fu Youde defeated him and accepted his surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，遣官省歷代帝王陵寢，禁芻牧，置守陵戶。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou—officials were dispatched to inspect the tombs of successive emperors; grazing was forbidden and tomb-guard households were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, commissioners were sent to inspect the tombs of successive emperors; grazing was forbidden and guardian households were assigned.

sentences.zh: 忠臣烈士祠，有司以時葺治。

translations.literal: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be maintained on schedule by the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to loyal ministers and martyrs were to be kept in repair on schedule by local authorities.

sentences.zh: 分遣國子生修嶽鎮海瀆祠。

translations.literal: National University students were dispatched separately to repair the shrines of the sacred mountains, guardian peaks, and rivers and seas.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the National University were sent out in separate parties to restore the shrines of the sacred mountains, guardian peaks, and great rivers and seas.

sentences.zh: 西番朵兒只巴寇罕東，河州指揮甯正擊走之。

translations.literal: The Tibetan Dorji Ba raided Handong; Hezhou Commander Ning Zheng drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan leader Dorji Ba raided Handong; Commander Ning Zheng of Hezhou repelled him.

sentences.zh: 閏九月庚寅，以災異詔求直言。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, gengyin—because of calamities and portents, an edict sought frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on the gengyin day, an edict called for candid memorials in response to omens and disasters.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，太廟成，自是行合享禮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiwei—the Grand Ancestral Temple was completed; from this time joint sacrifices were performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiwei day, the Grand Ancestral Temple was completed, and joint sacrifices were thereafter performed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命秦、晉、燕、吳、楚、齊諸王治兵鳳陽。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi were ordered to drill troops at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the princes of Qin, Jin, Yan, Wu, Chu, and Qi were ordered to conduct military exercises at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renwu—rites were performed at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 戊子，徙山西及真定民無產者田鳳陽。

translations.literal: On wuzi, landless people from Shanxi and Zhending were moved to farmland at Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, landless families from Shanxi and Zhending were resettled on farmland at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，振畿內、浙江、湖北水災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiayin—the metropolitan region, Zhejiang, and Hubei were relieved of flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiayin day, flood relief was extended to the metropolitan region, Zhejiang, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣都督同知沐英乘傳詣陝西問民疾苦。

translations.literal: On jimao, Assistant Chief Commander Mu Ying traveled by relay post to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Assistant Chief Commander Mu Ying was dispatched by relay post to Shaanxi to inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 是年，覽邦、琉球、安南、日本、烏斯藏、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Lambri, Ryukyu, Annam, Japan, U-Tsang, and Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived from Lambri, Ryukyu, Annam, Japan, U-Tsang, and Korea.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛卯，以羽林等衛軍益秦、晉、燕三府護衛。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, xinmao—troops of the Imperial Guard and other guards were added to the protective establishments of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princedoms.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, on the xinmao day of the first month, guardsmen of the Imperial Guard and other units were assigned to reinforce the protective establishments of the Qin, Jin, and Yan princedoms.

sentences.zh: 是春，振蘇、松、嘉、湖水災。

translations.literal: That spring, Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were relieved of flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, flood relief was extended to Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，鄧愈為征西將軍，沐英為副將軍，率師討吐番，大破之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiyou—Deng Yu was made Western Expedition General, with Mu Ying as deputy; they led the army to campaign against the Tibetans and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiyou day, Deng Yu was appointed Western Expedition General with Mu Ying as his deputy; they led an army against the Tibetans and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 是月，振太平、甯國及宜興、錢塘諸縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang were relieved of flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief was extended to Taiping, Ningguo, and the counties of Yixing and Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，韓國公李善長、曹國公李文忠總中書省、大都督府、御史台，議軍國重事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengzi—Duke of Han Li Shanchang and Duke of Cao Li Wenzhong jointly oversaw the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate weighty military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengzi day, Li Shanchang, Duke of Han, and Li Wenzhong, Duke of Cao, were placed jointly in charge of the Secretariat, the Chief Military Commission, and the Censorate to deliberate matters of military and state import.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，振湖廣水災。

translations.literal: On guimao, relief was extended for the flood disaster in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, flood relief was ordered for Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，戶部主事趙乾振荊、蘄遲緩，伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhao Gan, a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, was charged with sluggish relief in Jing and Qi and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zhao Gan, a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, was put to death for delaying flood relief in Jing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔臣民言事者，實封達御前。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingsi—an edict ordered that memorialists among officials and commoners should send sealed documents directly before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the dingsi day, an edict required that petitions from officials and commoners be sent in sealed envelopes directly to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命政事啟皇太子裁決奏聞。

translations.literal: On bingyin, it was ordered that administrative matters be opened to the Crown Prince for decision and reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the emperor directed that state affairs be presented to the crown prince for decision before being reported to him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，置通政司。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiashen—the Office of Transmission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the jiashen day, the Office of Transmission was established.

sentences.zh: 是月，始遣御史巡按州縣。

translations.literal: That month, censors were first dispatched to tour and inspect prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, censorial officials were first sent on inspection tours of the prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，改建大祀殿於南郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu—the Hall of Grand Sacrifice was rebuilt at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on the gengxu day, the Hall of Grand Sacrifice was rebuilt at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，選武臣子弟讀書國子監。

translations.literal: On guichou, sons and younger brothers of military officials were selected to study at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, sons of military officers were enrolled to study at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，振紹興、金華、衢州水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen—relief for flood disasters in Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the bingshen day, flood relief was ordered for Shaoxing, Jinhua, and Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，胡惟庸為左丞相，汪廣洋為右丞相。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Hu Weiyong was made Left Grand Councillor and Wang Guangyang Right Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Hu Weiyong was appointed left grand councillor and Wang Guangyang right grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，封沐英四平侯。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuwu—Mu Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Siping.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of the tenth month, on the wuwu day, Mu Ying was created Marquis of Siping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜百官公田。

translations.literal: On xinyou, public fields were granted to the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the court granted stipend fields to civil officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，衛國公鄧愈卒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guiwei—Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on the guiwei day, Deng Yu, Duke of Wei, died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，合祀天地於奉天殿。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Hall of Receiving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Heaven and Earth were worshipped together in the Hall of Receiving Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是月，免河南、陝西、廣東、湖廣田租。

translations.literal: That month, land tax was remitted in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, land tax was remitted in Henan, Shaanxi, Guangdong, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 威茂蠻叛，御史大夫丁玉為平羌將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: The Weimao tribes rebelled; Grand Censor Ding Yu was made Pacification General of the Qiang and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Weimao tribes rebelled; Grand Censor Ding Yu was appointed Pacification General of the Qiang and quelled the uprising.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day yisi—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, the yisi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，錄故功臣子孫百百餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On dingwei, more than a hundred descendants of former meritorious ministers were enrolled and granted offices of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, over a hundred descendants of deceased meritorious officials were registered and appointed to posts according to merit.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、三佛齊、暹羅、爪哇、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Cambodia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribute missions arrived from Champa, Srivijaya, Siam, Java, and Cambodia.

sentences.zh: 高麗使五至，以嗣王未立，卻之。

translations.literal: Korean envoys came five times; because the successor king had not been installed, they were turned away.
translations.idiomatic: Korean envoys arrived five times, but each embassy was refused because the heir to the throne had not yet been enthroned.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月甲戌，封皇子椿為蜀王，柏湘王，桂豫王，模漢王，植衛王。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, jiaxu—the princes Zhu Chun, Zhu Bai, Zhu Gui, Zhu Mo, and Zhu Zhi were enfeoffed as Princes of Shu, Xiang, Yu, Han, and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, on the jiaxu day of the first month, the emperor enfeoffed his sons Zhu Chun as Prince of Shu, Zhu Bai as Prince of Xiang, Zhu Gui as Prince of Yu, Zhu Mo as Prince of Han, and Zhu Zhi as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 改封吳王橚為周王。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Zhu Shuang was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shuang, Prince of Wu, was transferred to the Zhou princedom.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進封湯和信國公。

translations.literal: On jimao, Tang He was advanced to Duke of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Tang He was promoted to Duke of Xin.

sentences.zh: 是月，徵天下布政使及知府來朝。

translations.literal: That month, provincial intendants and prefectural magistrates throughout the realm were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, provincial intendants and prefectural magistrates from across the empire were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月，指揮胡淵平茂州蠻。

translations.literal: Second month—the commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Commander Hu Yuan pacified the Maozhou tribes.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，命奏事毋關白中書省。

translations.literal: Third month, renwu—it was ordered that reports of affairs need not pass through the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on the renwu day, memorials were ordered to bypass the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，第來朝官為三等。

translations.literal: That month, officials who had come to court were ranked in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: That month, officials attending court were ranked in three tiers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，元嗣君愛猷識理達臘殂，子脫古思帖木兒嗣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month—the Yuan heir Ayushiridara died; his son Toghus Temür succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the fourth month, the Yuan heir Ayushiridara died and was succeeded by his son Toghus Temür.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，存問蘇、松、嘉、湖被水災民，戶賜米一石，蠲逋賦六十五萬有奇。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingyou—the flood-stricken people of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu were inquired after; each household was granted one picul of grain, and overtaxes of more than 650,000 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on the dingyou day, the court inquired after flood victims in Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, granting each household one picul of grain and remitting over 650,000 in arrears.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，遣使祭故元嗣君。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi—envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the former Yuan heir.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the renzi day, envoys were sent to perform rites for the deceased Yuan heir.

sentences.zh: 己巳，五開蠻叛，殺靖州指揮過興，以辰州指揮楊仲名為總兵官，討之。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Wukai tribes rebelled and killed the Jingzhou commander Guo Xing; the Chenzhou commander Yang Zhongming was made supreme commander to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Wukai tribes rebelled and killed Guo Xing, commander of Jingzhou; Yang Zhongming, commander of Chenzhou, was appointed supreme commander to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，振平陽饑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou—relief for famine in Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the dingchou day, famine relief was ordered for Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，蘇、松、揚、臺海溢，遣官存恤。

translations.literal: That month, the seas overflowed in Su, Song, Yang, and Tai; officials were dispatched to comfort and aid.
translations.idiomatic: That month, coastal flooding struck Suzhou, Songjiang, Yangzhou, and Taizhou, and officials were sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，免應天、太平、鎮江、甯國、廣德諸府州秋糧。

translations.literal: Eighth month—autumn grain tax was remitted in the prefectures and circuits of Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, autumn grain tax was remitted in Yingtian, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，追封劉繼祖為義惠侯。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen—Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the bingshen day, Liu Jizu was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yihui.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，大祀殿成。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiazi—the Hall of Grand Sacrifice was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of the tenth month, on the jiazi day, the Hall of Grand Sacrifice was completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，征西將軍西平侯沐英率都督藍玉、玉弼討西番。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengwu—the Western Expedition General, Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying, led the commanders Lan Yu and Yubi to campaign against the Western Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on the gengwu day, Western Expedition General Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, led the commanders Lan Yu and Yubi in a campaign against the western tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，五開蠻平。

translations.literal: That month, the Wukai tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Wukai uprising was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、闍婆、高麗、琉球、占城、三佛齊、朵甘、烏斯藏、彭亨、百花入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Java, Korea, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Do-kham, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribute missions arrived from Siam, Java, Korea, Ryukyu, Champa, Srivijaya, Do-kham, U-Tsang, Pahang, and Baihua.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月己卯，始合禮天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, jimao—Heaven and Earth were first jointly worshipped according to ritual at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, on the jimao day of the first month, Heaven and Earth were first worshipped together at the southern altar according to the new ritual.

sentences.zh: 甲申，洮州十八族番叛，命沐英移兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the eighteen tribes of Taozhou rebelled; Mu Ying was ordered to shift his army to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the eighteen tribal groups of Taozhou rebelled, and Mu Ying was ordered to redeploy his forces to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，丁玉平松州蠻。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Ding Yu pacified the Songzhou tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，李文忠督理河、岷、臨、鞏軍事。

translations.literal: Second month, wuxu—Li Wenzhong supervised military affairs in He, Min, Lin, and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on the wuxu day, Li Wenzhong was placed in charge of military affairs along the He, Min, Lin, and Gong frontiers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「今春雨雪經旬。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict said: "Now spring rain and snow have lasted for ten days and more.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an edict proclaimed: "Spring rains and snow have persisted for more than ten days.

sentences.zh: 天下貧民困於饑寒者多有，其令有司給以鈔。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm many poor people are afflicted by hunger and cold; let the responsible offices distribute paper money to them."
translations.idiomatic: Many of the empire's poor now suffer hunger and cold. Let the appropriate offices distribute paper currency in relief."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，信國公湯和率列候練兵臨清。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Duke of Xin Tang He led the various marquises to drill troops at Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Tang He, Duke of Xin, led the marquises in military exercises at Linqing.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，蠲北平田租。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, guiwei—land tax in Beiping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the fifth month, on the guiwei day, land tax was remitted in Beiping.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，都督馬雲征大寧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingmao—the director Ma Yun campaigned against Daining.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the dingmao day, Director Ma Yun marched against Daining.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，丁玉回師討眉縣賊，平之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingchen—Ding Yu turned his army back to suppress the bandits of Meixian and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the seventh month, on the bingchen day, Ding Yu wheeled his army about to crush the Meixian rebels and pacified the district.

sentences.zh: 己未，李文忠還掌大都督府事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Wenzhong returned to manage the affairs of the Metropolitan Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Li Wenzhong resumed direction of the Metropolitan Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，詔凡致仕官復其家，終身無所與。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinsi—an edict ordered that retired officials have their households restored and be free of all obligations for life.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on the xinsi day, an edict declared that retired officials' households would be restored and that they would owe the state no further service for life.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，沐英大破西番，擒其部長三副使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jihai—Mu Ying inflicted a great defeat on the Western Barbarians and captured three of their deputy chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the jihai day, Mu Ying routed the western tribes and captured three of their deputy chieftains.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，沐英班師，封仇成、藍玉等十二人為侯。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, jiawu—Mu Ying returned from campaign; Chou Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, Mu Ying withdrew from the field; Chou Cheng, Lan Yu, and twelve others were created marquises.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大寧平。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Daining was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Daining was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月，汪廣洋貶廣南，賜死。

translations.literal: Twelfth month—Wang Guangyang was demoted to Guangnan and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wang Guangyang was banished to Guangnan and compelled to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 徵天下博學老成之士至京師。

translations.literal: Learned and mature scholars throughout the realm were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erudite and seasoned scholars from across the empire were summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、爪哇、暹羅、日本、安南、高麗入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annam, and Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribute missions arrived from Champa, Java, Siam, Japan, Annam, and Korea.

sentences.zh: 高麗貢黃金百斤、白金萬兩，以不如約，卻之。

translations.literal: Korea presented one hundred jin of gold and ten thousand liang of silver; because the gifts did not conform to the treaty, they were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Korea offered a hundred jin of gold and ten thousand liang of silver, but the embassy was turned away for failing to observe the stipulated protocol.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊戌，左丞相胡惟庸謀反，及其黨御史大夫陳甯、中丞塗節等伏誅。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, wuxu—Left Grand Councillor Hu Weiyong plotted rebellion; his partisans Grand Censor Chen Ning, Vice Censor Tu Jie, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirteenth year, on the wuxu day of the first month, left grand councillor Hu Weiyong was executed for treason, along with his confederates Grand Censor Chen Ning, Vice Censor Tu Jie, and others.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On guimao, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 罷中書省，廢丞相等官，更定六部官秩，改大都督府為中、左、右、前、後五軍都督府。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat was abolished, the posts of grand councillor and the like were eliminated, the official ranks of the Six Ministries were revised, and the Metropolitan Military Commission was changed into the five military commissions of Center, Left, Right, Forward, and Rear.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was abolished and the chancellorship eliminated; the Six Ministries were reorganized, and the Metropolitan Military Commission was divided into five army commissions—Center, Left, Right, Forward, and Rear.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，詔舉聰明正直、孝弟力田、賢良方正、文學術數之士。

translations.literal: Second month, new year's day renxu—an edict ordered the recommendation of men who were intelligent and upright, filial and diligent in farming, worthy and upright, and skilled in letters and occult calculation.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the second month, an edict called for recommendations of the intelligent and upright, the filial and industrious farmers, the worthy and upright, and men accomplished in letters and the occult arts.

sentences.zh: 發丹符，驗天下金穀之數。

translations.literal: Red tally tokens were issued to verify the empire's grain and treasure accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Red tally tokens were dispatched to audit grain stores and treasury holdings throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，文武官年六十以上者聽致仕，給以誥敕。

translations.literal: On wuchen, civil and military officials aged sixty or more were permitted to retire and were given patents of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, civil and military officials aged sixty or above were permitted to retire with patents of honor.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，減蘇、松、嘉、湖重賦十之二。

translations.literal: Third month, renchen—the heavy levies of Su, Song, Jia, and Hu were reduced by two-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on the renchen day, the crushing tax burden of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was cut by twenty percent.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，燕王隸之國北平。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Prince of Yan Zhu Di went to his enfeoffment in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, departed for his princedom at Beiping.

sentences.zh: 壬子，沐英襲元將脫火赤於亦集乃，擒之，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: On renzi, Mu Ying ambushed the Yuan general Tohochu at Yijinai, captured him, and all his followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Mu Ying surprised the Yuan general Tohochu at Yijinai, took him captive, and received the surrender of his entire force.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，命群臣各舉所知。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou—it was ordered that each minister recommend men he knew.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the fourth month, on the jichou day, every minister was ordered to recommend men of talent known to him.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，雷震謹身殿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu—thunder struck the Hall of Self-Cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on the jiawu day, lightning struck the Hall of Self-Cultivation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大赦。

translations.literal: On yiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，釋在京及臨濠屯田輸作者。

translations.literal: On bingshen, corvée laborers performing transport duties in the capital and at the Linhuang garrisons were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, transport corvée laborers in the capital and at the Linhuang garrisons were released from service.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免天下田租。

translations.literal: On jihai, land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, land tax was remitted empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 吏以過誤罷者還其職。

translations.literal: Officials dismissed for minor faults were restored to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Officials removed for trifling errors were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，都督濮英進兵赤斤站，獲故元豳王亦憐真及其部曲而還。

translations.literal: On renyin, Director Pu Ying advanced to Chijin Station, captured the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen and his retinue, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Director Pu Ying marched to Chijin Station, seized the former Yuan Prince of Bin Yilianzhen together with his followers, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷御史台。

translations.literal: That month, the Censorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Censorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 命從征士卒老疾者許以子代，老而無子及寡婦，有司資遣還。

translations.literal: It was ordered that campaign veterans who were old or ill might be replaced by their sons; those old and sonless, and widows, were to be provided funds by the responsible offices and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Veterans of the campaigns who were aged or infirm might send sons in their stead; those without sons, and army widows, were to be given travel funds by local authorities and sent home.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，雷震奉天門，避正殿省愆。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingyin—thunder struck the Gate of Receiving Heaven; the emperor avoided the main hall and examined his faults.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the bingyin day, lightning struck the Gate of Receiving Heaven; the emperor withdrew from the main hall to examine his own conduct.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷王府工役。

translations.literal: On dingmao, corvée labor for princely establishments was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, corvée labor for princely establishments was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，置諫院官。

translations.literal: On dingchou, officials of the Remonstrance Bureau were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, posts in the Remonstrance Bureau were established.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，命天下學校師生，日給廩膳。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month—it was ordered that teachers and students in schools throughout the realm receive daily grain stipends.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of the eighth month, teachers and students in schools across the empire were granted daily grain rations.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，景川侯曹震、營陽侯楊璟、永城侯恭顯屯田北平。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinmao—the Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, the Marquis of Yingyang Yang Jing, and the Marquis of Yongcheng Gong Xian garrisoned and farmed in Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the xinmao day, Marquis Cao Zhen of Jingchuan, Marquis Yang Jing of Yingyang, and Marquis Gong Xian of Yongcheng were stationed in Beiping to farm garrison lands.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天壽節，始受群臣朝賀，賜宴於謹身殿，後以為常。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Heavenly Longevity Festival—the emperor first received congratulations from the ministers and granted a feast in the Hall of Self-Cultivation; thereafter this became customary.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the emperor's birthday was celebrated for the first time with court congratulations and a feast in the Hall of Self-Cultivation—a practice thereafter observed annually.

sentences.zh: 丙午，置四輔官，告於太廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Four Assistants were established and announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Four Assistants were installed and their appointment announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 以儒士王本、估佑、襲斅、杜斅、趙民望、吳源為春、夏官。

translations.literal: The Confucian scholars Wang Ben, Gu You, Xi Xiao, Du Jiao, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were made Spring and Summer officials.
translations.idiomatic: The scholar-officials Wang Ben, Gu You, Xi Xiao, Du Jiao, Zhao Minwang, and Wu Yuan were appointed to the Spring and Summer posts among the Four Assistants.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔陝西衛軍以三分之二屯田。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered that two-thirds of the Shaanxi guard troops be put to garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict directed that two-thirds of the Shaanxi garrison troops be assigned to military colonies.

sentences.zh: 安置翰林學士承旨宋濂於茂州，道卒。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Expositor Song Lian was installed at Maozhou and died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Song Lian was sent into exile at Maozhou and died on the journey.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，徐達還。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, yiwei—Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: In winter of the eleventh month, on the yiwei day, Xu Da returned to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，元平章完者不花、乃兒不花犯永平，指揮劉廣戰沒，千戶王輅擊敗之，擒完者不花。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Yuan pingzhang Wan Zhebughua and Nayir Buqa invaded Yongping; the commander Liu Guang died in battle; the chiliarch Wang He defeated them and captured Wan Zhebughua.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the Yuan ministers Wan Zhebughua and Nayir Buqa raided Yongping; Commander Liu Guang fell in battle, but Chiliarch Wang He routed the invaders and captured Wan Zhebughua.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天下府州縣所舉士至者八百六十餘人，授官有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month—more than eight hundred and sixty scholars recommended by prefectures, districts, and counties throughout the realm arrived and were granted offices of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, more than eight hundred and sixty locally recommended scholars reached the capital and were appointed to posts according to merit.

sentences.zh: 南雄侯趙庸鎮廣東，討陽春蠻。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Nanxiong Zhao Yong garrisoned Guangdong and suppressed the Yangchun tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yong, Marquis of Nanxiong, was stationed in Guangdong to suppress the Yangchun tribes.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、日本、安南、占城、真臘、爪哇入貢，日本以無表卻之。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Japan, Annam, Champa, Cambodia, and Java sent tribute; Japan was refused for lacking a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribute arrived from Ryukyu, Japan, Annam, Champa, Cambodia, and Java, though the Japanese embassy was turned away for presenting no formal memorial.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月戊子，徐達為征虜大將軍，湯和、傅友德為左、右副將軍，帥師討乃兒不花。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, wuzi—Xu Da was made Grand General Expelling the Barbarians; Tang He and Fu Youde were made Left and Right Deputy Generals; they led an army to campaign against Nayir Buqa.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourteenth year, on the wuzi day of the first month, Xu Da was appointed Grand General Expelling the Barbarians, with Tang He and Fu Youde as his left and right deputies, to lead a punitive expedition against Nayir Buqa.

sentences.zh: 命新授官者各舉所知。

translations.literal: Newly appointed officials were ordered each to recommend men he knew.
translations.idiomatic: Every newly appointed official was ordered to recommend men of talent known to him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Heaven and Earth were greatly sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the emperor offered the great joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷天下歲造兵器。

translations.literal: On renzi, the empire-wide annual manufacture of weapons was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the annual empire-wide manufacture of weapons was halted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命公候子弟入國學。

translations.literal: On guichou, it was ordered that sons of dukes and marquises enter the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, sons of dukes and marquises were ordered to enroll in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔求隱逸。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict sought recluses.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict called for hidden men of talent to come forward.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，核天下官田。

translations.literal: Second month, gengchen—official fields throughout the realm were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on the gengchen day, official landholdings throughout the empire were audited.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，大赦。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu—a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on the bingxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，頒《五經》、《四書》於北方學校。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Five Classics and the Four Books were distributed to schools in the north.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, copies of the Five Classics and the Four Books were issued to schools in the north.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，徐達率諸將出塞，至北黃河，擊破元兵，獲全寧四部以歸。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengwu—Xu Da led the generals beyond the passes to the northern Yellow River, defeated the Yuan army, and returned with the four tribes of Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengwu day, Xu Da led his commanders out of the frontier to the northern Yellow River, routed the Yuan forces, and brought back the four Quanning tribes in triumph.

sentences.zh: 五月，五溪蠻叛，江夏侯周德興討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month—the Wuxi barbarians rebelled; Jiangxia Marquis Zhou Dexing suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Wuxi tribes rose in revolt; Marquis Zhou Dexing of Jiangxia marched against them and restored order.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子，詔求明經老成之士，有司禮送京師。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, bingzi—an edict sought scholars versed in the classics who were mature in years; the responsible offices were to escort them with ritual courtesy to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the bingzi day, the throne called for seasoned classicists; local authorities were to conduct them to the capital with full ceremonial honors.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，河決原武、祥符、中牟。

translations.literal: Gengchen—the Yellow River burst its banks at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Yellow River broke through at Yuanwu, Xiangfu, and Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徐達還。

translations.literal: Xinsi—Xu Da returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Xu Da returned from campaign.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，傅友德為征南將軍，藍玉、沐英為左、右副將軍，帥征支南。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day of renwu—Fu Youde was made Campaigning General of the South; Lan Yu and Mu Ying were made Left and Right Vice Generals, and they led the expedition against Zhīnán.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, Fu Youde was appointed general of the southern expedition, with Lan Yu and Mu Ying as his left and right deputies, and they took the field against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 徐達鎮北平。

translations.literal: Xu Da garrisoned Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Da was posted to hold Beiping.

sentences.zh: 丙午，周德興移師討施州蠻，平之。

translations.literal: Bingwu—Zhou Dexing shifted his forces to attack the Shizhou barbarians and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zhou Dexing redeployed his army against the Shizhou tribes and subdued them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day of renzi—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day of the month, a solar eclipse was observed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命法司錄囚，會翰林院給事中及春坊官會議平允以聞。

translations.literal: Guichou—the judicial offices were ordered to review prisoners; supervising secretaries of the Hanlin Academy and Eastern Palace officials were convened to deliberate on fairness and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the judiciary was commanded to review cases in custody; Hanlin supervising secretaries and Eastern Palace officers met to judge what was equitable and report upward.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免應天、太平、應德、鎮江、甯國田租。

translations.literal: Jiayin—land tax was remitted for Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, land taxes were waived in Yingtian, Taiping, Yingde, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分遣御史錄囚。

translations.literal: Guihai—censors were dispatched separately to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, investigating censors were sent out in separate circuits to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，延安侯唐勝宗帥師討浙東山寇，平之。

translations.literal: Jimao—Yan'an Marquis Tang Shengzong led troops against the mountain bandits of eastern Zhèjiāng and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Marquis Tang Shengzong of Yan'an led a force against the mountain rebels of eastern Zhejiang and brought them to heel.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，吉安侯陸仲亨鎮成都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renwu—Ji'an Marquis Lu Zhongheng garrisoned Chéngdū.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Marquis Lu Zhongheng of Ji'an was stationed at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙庸討廣州海寇，大破之。

translations.literal: Gengxu—Zhao Yong attacked the sea bandits of Guǎngzhōu and utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zhao Yong struck the pirates off Guangzhou and broke them decisively.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，命翰林春坊官考駁諸司章奏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingsi—the Hanlin and Eastern Palace officials were ordered to examine and criticize memorials from the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, Hanlin and Eastern Palace officers were charged with reviewing and correcting memorials submitted by the ministries.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，傅友德大敗元兵於白石江，遂下曲靖。

translations.literal: Wuchen—Fu Youde utterly defeated the Yuan army at the Baishi River and then took Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Fu Youde routed the Yuan army at the Baishi River and pressed on to capture Qujing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，元梁王把匝剌瓦爾密走普寧自殺。

translations.literal: Renshen—the Yuan Liang King Bazhala'ermi fled to Puning and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the Yuan prince of Liang, Bazhala'ermi, fled to Puning and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、安南、爪哇、朵甘、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year—Siam, Annam, Java, Duogan, and U-Tsang presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, embassies arrived bearing tribute from Siam, Annam, Java, Duogan, and Ü-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 以安南寇思明，不納。

translations.literal: Because Annam raided Siming, tribute was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute from Annam was refused, for its forces had raided Siming.
